note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 305 homes for sale in France, each one checked by a person.
In France, the median asking price of those 305 homes is €124,800 (€1,053 per m², from the 302 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €39,000 and the most expensive €214,000.
Taxes and fees add about 7–8.5% to the price of a home in France (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer taxes (droits de mutation) of about 5.8%, or about 6.3% in departments that raised their rate for 2025 to March 2028; notary fee (émoluments) on a sliding scale from 3.87% down to 0.799% plus 20% VAT, about 1.3% on a €150,000 home; land security contribution (contribution de sécurité immobilière) 0.10%; disbursements (débours) of about €800 to €1,200; the agent fee is usually built into the advertised price (FAI) and paid by the seller, sometimes shared.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. Foreigners can buy property in France without major restrictions, and non-EU buyers do not need a permit, although the paperwork can take longer.
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners pay an annual property tax (taxe foncière) set by the local authorities, and owners of a furnished second home also pay housing tax (taxe d'habitation), which some communes raise by a surcharge of 5% to 60%.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents pay French income tax on French rental income at a minimum rate of 20% (30% above about €27,500), plus social charges of 17.2%, or 7.5% for people covered by social security in another EU/EEA country or Switzerland.

homes.title: 171 m² house with a former shop in the centre of Bussière-Poitevine
homes.title_es: Casa de 171 m² con antiguo local comercial en el centro de Bussière-Poitevine
homes.summary: In the heart of the village, next to the baker, pharmacy and school: a cellar, a kitchen, a living room, a WC and a former shop with a street window on the ground floor; two bedrooms and two shower rooms on the first floor; and a near-independent top floor with its own kitchen, living room, bedroom and shower room. Room for a family, a business with living space or a holiday let. On the Limoges–Poitiers road. Asking €39,950, about €234/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom house with cellar and outbuildings in Monts-sur-Guesnes, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa lista para entrar a vivir de 4 dormitorios con sótano y dependencias en Monts-sur-Guesnes, Vienne
homes.summary: Move-in ready house in Monts-sur-Guesnes, with 238 m² of living space and 4 bedrooms. It includes a 38 m² living room, a 34 m² fitted kitchen with a wood stove, a bathroom and a separate toilet. Extras include a cellar, a courtyard, outbuildings, a separate plot for 2 vehicles and a large insulated attic. Double glazing, mains drainage and 2 chimney flues ready for a pellet or wood stove are included. Schools, shops and a doctor are in the village, 17 km from Loudun and 46 km from Poitiers. Asking €95,700, about €402/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom stone house with balcony and views in Aubin, Aveyron
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 2 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con balcón y vistas en Aubin, Aveyron
homes.summary: This move-in ready house in Aubin is a stone village home with habitable living spaces. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and 132 m2 of living area. A balcony offers panoramic village and mountain views, and the property includes 840 sq ft of land. Double glazing is fitted, and village shops and cafés are within walking distance. Rodez is about 38 km away and Toulouse-Blagnac Airport about 150 km. Asking €59,400, about €450/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom house with courtyard and barn in Les Salles-Lavauguyon, Haute-Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 4 dormitorios con patio y granero en Les Salles-Lavauguyon, Haute-Vienne
homes.summary: Renovated four-bedroom house of 180 m2 in the centre of a village. The ground floor has a tiled hall, kitchen, living room, dining room, WC and a bedroom or office. Upstairs, three bedrooms include two with en suite shower rooms and a large separate bathroom. The 2,583 sq ft plot includes a courtyard with patio doors from the living room and a little barn. It has electric heating and an attic that could be partly converted, subject to permissions. Asking €99,999, about €556/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom family house with garden and garages in Magnac-Laval, Limousin
homes.title_es: Casa familiar de 4 dormitorios totalmente reformada con jardín y garajes en Magnac-Laval, Limusín
homes.summary: This fully renovated house has been rewired, replumbed and fitted with full double glazing. It has 4 double bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 extra cloakrooms, a kitchen/dining room and a separate lounge. Outside there is a south facing garden with a terrace, outbuildings, 2 attached garages and a barn. The kitchen/dining room and lounge each have a woodburner, and the home has wood heating. The historic centre of Magnac-Laval is about 200 m away, and Limoges airport is a 45 minute drive. Asking €100,000, about €633/m².

homes.title: Stone country house from 1550 with a mezzanine and 1,686 m² of land in Nieuil, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de piedra de 1550 con altillo y 1.686 m² de terreno en Nieuil, Charente
homes.summary: A stone country house dating from 1550 in a quiet hamlet, 5 km from shops. It was renovated between 2005 and 2010: the old part keeps a living room with a big fireplace and a bedroom, the renovated part has an open fitted kitchen, a shower room and a mezzanine under the roof. Semi-detached, on 1,686 m² of land with trees. Asking €109,760, about €946/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 19th-century longère on one level with garage in Lencloître, Vienne
homes.title_es: Longère del siglo XIX totalmente renovada en una planta con garaje en Lencloître, Vienne
homes.summary: A 19th-century longère, fully renovated and all on one level. East and west light fills a living room, lounge and dining room; the modern kitchen is separate. Two bedrooms, a laundry, a garage and a 620 m² garden with a terrace. Energy rating D. Asking €123,000, about €1,206/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a 60 m² living space and mezzanine near Villefagnan, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada con 60 m² de zona de día y altillo cerca de Villefagnan, Charente
homes.summary: A well renovated stone house in a hamlet 2 km from Villefagnan and 7 km from Ruffec. The 60 m² living space has a 12 kW wood stove and an open fitted kitchen with a 12.5 m² pantry. A bedroom, a walk-in shower room and a WC are on the ground floor; a 19.5 m² mezzanine and two more bedrooms upstairs. 153 m² on a 1,334 m² plot. Energy rating D. Asking €125,000, about €817/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with open countryside views and a heat pump near Saint-Vaury, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada con vistas abiertas al campo y bomba de calor cerca de Saint-Vaury, Creuse
homes.summary: A renovated stone house with a wide open view over the Creuse countryside. Dining room with fitted kitchen, a lounge and a shower room downstairs; a landing office, two bedrooms and a second shower room upstairs. Air-to-air heat pump on the ground floor, compliant drainage and energy rating C. 931 m² of land. Asking €136,250, about €1,390/m².

homes.title: Renovated old house with stone walls and terracotta floors in the Perche, 3 minutes from Nogent-le-Rotrou
homes.title_es: Casa antigua renovada con muros de piedra y suelos de barro en el Perche, a 3 minutos de Nogent-le-Rotrou
homes.summary: A renovated old house in a hamlet of only three houses, with an open view, three minutes from Nogent-le-Rotrou. The living room keeps its terracotta tiles and stone walls, with a pellet stove and an open fitted kitchen. Three bedrooms and a shower room upstairs. A front courtyard and a small garden with trees on 386 m². Energy rating D. Asking €137,900, about €1,702/m².

homes.title: Former level-crossing keeper's house renovated in 2023 on 1,824 m² in Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Antigua casa de guardabarrera renovada en 2023 con 1.824 m² en Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.summary: An old level-crossing keeper's house, 2.5 km from the centre of Bergerac, fully renovated in 2023. Downstairs a fully equipped kitchen opens to the dining room, with a bedroom, a shower room and a laundry on the same level. Upstairs a landing room for an office and a large bedroom. The fenced 1,824 m² plot has a well and a vaulted cellar. Energy rating D. Asking €139,000, about €1,805/m².

homes.title: Brick house with a 2019 living-room extension, garden and garage in Ohain, Avesnois
homes.title_es: Casa de ladrillo con ampliación del salón de 2019, jardín y garaje en Ohain, Avesnois
homes.summary: A semi-detached brick house in the green Avesnois, next to the Belgian border. The living space with dining area, kitchen and lounge sits in an extension built in 2019, with a shower room on the same floor. Three bedrooms upstairs. PVC double glazing throughout, mains drainage and a redone electrical panel. Terrace, garden, a large garage and parking on 490 m². Energy rating D. Asking €148,400, about €1,400/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 250 m² house from 1900 with five bedrooms in La Courtine, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa de 1900 totalmente renovada de 250 m² con cinco dormitorios en La Courtine, Creuse
homes.summary: A traditional house from 1900, fully renovated, in a village with all services. A large bright living room, an open fitted kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room make a complete ground floor. Four bedrooms and a second shower room upstairs, and one more room on the top floor. Built over a cellar with a boiler room and workshop, with a tended garden of 876 m². Energy rating D. Asking €149,000, about €596/m².

homes.title: Renovated three-level house with an energy rating C in Decazeville, Aveyron
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de tres plantas con certificado C en Decazeville, Aveyron
homes.summary: A neat, renovated townhouse: a cellar, a laundry and an entrance on the ground floor; a bright living room with an open kitchen, a bedroom and a WC on the first floor; more bedrooms, a modern shower room, a separate WC and a study on the second. Laminate floors, white walls and energy rating C, so low running costs. Figeac and the Lot valley are close. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €49,980, about €431/m².

homes.title: Four-room 71 m² flat with two balconies in Mulhouse
homes.title_es: Piso de cuatro estancias y 71 m² con dos balcones en Mulhouse
homes.summary: 71 m² on the 4th floor: a spacious living room with a balcony, a fitted kitchen with a second balcony, three bright bedrooms, a bathroom with a bath, a separate WC and a cellar. Built-in wardrobes in the hall. Energy rating F, no lift. Asking €51,800, about €730/m².

homes.title: Country house with a veranda near the Saint-Rémy lake, Thiers
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con veranda junto al lago de Saint-Rémy, Thiers
homes.summary: In a quiet hamlet 5 km from Thiers and the Saint-Rémy-sur-Durolle lake: a bright veranda, an open kitchen onto a living room with a fireplace insert; two bedrooms, a study, a bathroom and a WC on the first floor; a spacious third bedroom and an attic on the second. Electric heating; energy rating G (about €2,400–3,300 a year). Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €49,900, about €416/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom house with garden and garage in Manot, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa lista para entrar a vivir de 4 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Manot, Charente
homes.summary: This move-in ready house is furnished and ready to move in or rent. It has a living room, a fitted and equipped kitchen, four bedrooms, a shower room with WC and a bathroom with WC. Outside, you get a separate garden of 219 m2, an adjoining garage of 17 m2 and 3,595 sq ft of land. It has oil central heating and mains drainage, and it is 9 km from Confolens in the centre of the village with local shops. Asking €60,500, about €582/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom townhouse with river views and fireplace in Chabanais, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 2 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con vistas al río en Chabanais, Charente
homes.summary: Move-in ready townhouse with original wooden flooring and staircase, arranged over three floors. It has two bedrooms, plus an attic room used as a third bedroom, with a shower room and WC on the ground floor and a bathroom and WC on the first floor. Other features include a fireplace, 732 sq ft of land and superb views over the river, which is within walking distance. Town gas central heating is fitted, and shops and restaurants are within easy walking distance. Asking €64,500, about €665/m².

homes.title: Restored 4-bedroom timber-framed house with garden and terrace in Le Neufour, Meuse, Lorraine
homes.title_es: Casa restaurada de 4 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en Le Neufour, Meuse, Lorraine
homes.summary: Restored house built in 1850, with a facade restored in 2013 and a structure in good condition. It has four bedrooms, a living-kitchen, a living room and a shower room upstairs. A large rear garden has fruit trees and a pond, plus a covered terrace. The home also has a fireplace, a cellar, wood stoves and 10,979 sq ft of land. Heating is electric upstairs and wood stoves downstairs, and Clermont-en-Argonne is about 7 minutes away. Asking €95,000, about €633/m².

homes.title: Detached 2-bedroom house with garden and large barns in Les Grands-Chézeaux, Haute-Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 2 dormitorios con jardín y amplios graneros en Les Grands-Chézeaux, Haute-Vienne
homes.summary: Detached house with 132 m2 of living space, 2 bedrooms and a roof in good condition. The ground floor has a living room, kitchen with dining area, bedroom, bathroom and separate toilet, and the first floor has a mezzanine bedroom. Outside, a 1930 m2 garden sits behind the house with a laid terrace and two barns of about 80 m2 each plus two smaller barns. Wood heating and a fireplace are listed, and St Sulpice-Les-Feuilles is a 5-minute drive away. Asking €98,975, about €750/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready stone townhouse with fireplace and terrace in Montsecret-Clairefougère, Normandy
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de piedra lista para entrar a vivir con chimenea en Montsecret-Clairefougère, Normandía
homes.summary: This move-in ready stone townhouse is ready to move in now, in a small village with a shop. It has 4 rooms, including 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a separate toilet and a 28 m2 living room/kitchen with a fireplace. Outdoor features include a terrace, a covered patio and 1,238 sq ft of land. Electric radiators provide heating, and the home has fibre and collective sewer sanitation. Tinchebray is 6 km away and Flers is 11 km away. Asking €69,000, about €663/m².

homes.title: House with fireplaces, large barn and land in Availles-Limouzine, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa con chimeneas, gran granero y terreno en Availles-Limouzine, Vienne
homes.summary: This is a six-bedroom house in Availles-Limouzine, a village on the banks of the Vienne River. The ground floor has an eat-in kitchen and a large living room, both with fireplaces, plus a bathroom, a separate WC and a bedroom with its own fireplace. Upstairs are five bedrooms. The plot covers 2,744 m² with a large barn or garage that could take a second floor. The home has wood heating, and Confolens is about 17 minutes by car. Asking €79,900, about €655/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom brick house with garage, cellars and outbuildings in Orbec, Calvados
homes.title_es: Casa de ladrillo de 4 dormitorios con garaje, sótanos y dependencias en Orbec, Calvados
homes.summary: This brick house offers 142 m2 of living space across 6 rooms, with 4 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. It has an entrance hall, a kitchen, two living rooms of 20 m2 each and a toilet with a sink, plus upstairs a dressing room and a separate toilet. Extras include a 50 m2 garage, a second outbuilding, two cellars, an attic and a 3,100 sq ft plot. The house is 10 km from Orbec and 13 km from Vimoutiers. Asking €87,500, about €616/m².

homes.title: Spacious 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Collorec, Finistère, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa espaciosa de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Collorec, Finisterre, Bretaña
homes.summary: This spacious two-floor house has three bedrooms and 170 m2 of living area. The ground floor includes a large lounge and dining room, a kitchen, a utility room and a toilet, while upstairs there is an office, three bedrooms and a shower room with toilet. Outside, you will find a garden, a garage and an outbuilding used as a boiler room, set on 6,103 sq ft of land. A large attic provides storage or potential for conversion, subject to feasibility, with electric heating and air conditioning. Asking €103,000, about €606/m².

homes.title: House in good condition with garden and garage in Cérilly, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa en buen estado con jardín y garaje en Cérilly, Allier
homes.summary: This characterful house is in good condition with five bedrooms, two bathrooms and a separate kitchen. The ground floor has a living room, kitchen and bedroom, and the first floor has three bedrooms and a dressing room. Features include a south-facing garden of 120 m², a garage, a vaulted cellar, a fireplace and 1,292 sq ft of land. Electric heating and a large attic complete the house. It is 3 km from the Tronçais forest, near village shops, and 22 minutes by car from the train station. Asking €119,000, about €580/m².

homes.title: Three-storey 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and sauna in Fenioux, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa de tres plantas con 4 dormitorios, jardín, terraza y sauna en Fenioux, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: This three-storey house is a maison bourgeoise with four bedrooms and 202 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a living room with a fireplace and a kitchen/diner with a log burner opening onto the terrace. Upstairs there are four bedrooms, two shower rooms, a bathroom and a sauna. Outside there is a terrace with a pergola, a garden, about 600 m2 of land, a cellar and a garage. Heating is by wood-burning stove and electric convectors, with Coulonges-sur-l'Autize 10 minutes away and Niort 30 minutes. Asking €124,800, about €618/m².

homes.title: Two-level 4-bedroom house with garden and garage in Buxières-sous-les-Côtes, Meuse, Lorraine
homes.title_es: Casa de dos plantas de 4 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Buxières-sous-les-Côtes, Meuse, Lorraine
homes.summary: This semi-detached house spreads 170 m² of living space over two levels. Four bedrooms, one bathroom, a shower room and a separate kitchen. Outdoor and extra features include a 240 m² garden, a terrace, a 41 m² garage, a cellar, a fireplace and 3,638 sq ft of land. Heating is by fuel boiler and open fireplace, with a micro-station for sanitation. Lake La Madine is 10 minutes away and Meuse TGV Station 15 minutes. Asking €125,000, about €735/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom cottage with garden and garage in Trie-sur-Baïse, Hautes-Pyrénées
homes.title_es: Casa de campo reformada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Trie-sur-Baïse, Hautes-Pyrénées
homes.summary: Renovated semi-detached cottage built in 1776, with a light triple-aspect living room featuring a fireplace and French doors to the terrace. It has three bedrooms, one of them on the ground floor, plus a games room or studio of 58.5 m² on the first floor with a balcony. The property has a garden with gated entry, a garage with parking for two cars, and electric radiators for heating. It is on the outskirts of Trie-sur-Baïse, within walking distance of shops, bars and restaurants. Asking €149,500, about €767/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom cottage with barn and land in Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de 2 dormitorios con granero y terreno en Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente
homes.summary: This two-bedroom cottage sits in a well maintained hamlet in Exideuil-sur-Vienne. Downstairs is an open plan kitchen, lounge and dining area, and upstairs has two bedrooms that take double beds and the bathroom. A good sized barn stands to the side, and a sizeable plot of 1460 m2 lies a short walk away. Canoeing and other water sports on the Vienne river are nearby. The home has 84 m2 of living space and electric heating. Asking €56,000, about €667/m².

homes.title: Cottage with barn, fireplace and garden in Bussière-Poitevine, Haute-Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con granero, chimenea y jardín en Bussière-Poitevine, Haute-Vienne
homes.summary: This cottage sits in a quiet hamlet and is ideal to lock up and leave. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a cosy living room with a fireplace, and a kitchen diner. Outside there is a wooden deck, a large attached barn, a 710 m² garden opposite the house and 2.85 acres of land. Heating is by wood, and the village with shops and a medical centre is a few minutes away. Limoges and Poitiers airports are about 50 minutes away. Asking €60,000, about €667/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and countryside views in Sanxay, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y vistas al campo en Sanxay, Vienne
homes.summary: This renovated house on medieval foundations is suitable for all year living. It has an open-plan kitchen and living-dining room, a large bedroom with shower room, and two bedrooms upstairs with a bathroom. Features include a garden courtyard, a wine cellar, an attached garage for one car, 1,507 sq ft of land and countryside views. The river is within walking distance, and gas central heating is fitted. Golf is 30 minutes away, and the coast and airports are 1h30 by car. Asking €86,000, about €956/m².

homes.title: Character 5-bedroom townhouse with enclosed garden in Saint-Fraimbault, Orne, Normandy
homes.title_es: Casa adosada con carácter de 5 dormitorios y jardín cerrado en Saint-Fraimbault, Orne, Normandía
homes.summary: This character townhouse, dating from the 1800s, has five bedrooms and 177 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a kitchen/dining room, sitting room, bedroom, shower room, WC and utility room, and the first floor has four bedrooms and a bathroom. An enclosed garden with mature trees lies to the rear on a 353 m2 plot, with an attic suitable for conversion. A lakeside walk is a short stroll away, and the village has a grocery shop and bar/restaurant. Heating is oil-fired, with mains drainage and recent rewiring. Asking €112,500, about €636/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Antugnac, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Antugnac, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This house in the village of Antugnac offers approximately 160 m2 of living space on three levels. It has three bedrooms, a 26 m2 ground floor room, a 23 m2 living room, a 17.75 m2 dining room and a 10.73 m2 open-plan kitchen. Outdoor features include a rear garden, a front courtyard, a large garage, one parking space, 5,167 sq ft of land and two stone outbuildings. The village is about 40 minutes from Carcassonne and its airport, and less than an hour from the Pyrenees. Asking €115,000, about €719/m².

homes.title: 3-bed stone house in the heart of a village
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios en pleno centro del pueblo
homes.summary: Stone house in the center of a village : Le Lonzac, Nouvelle-Aquitaine Right in the heart of village life, this stone village house offers a lovely balance of indoor space and outdoor corners to enjoy.

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom house with land and wood stove in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa totalmente reformada de 3 dormitorios con terreno y estufa de leña en Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.summary: A fully renovated house in a small peaceful village, suited to a family or as a second home. It has three bedrooms, one on the ground floor and two upstairs, with the possibility of converting a fourth. The property has 105 m2 of living space and 5,156 sq ft of land, along with a separate equipped kitchen and a shower room. Heating comes from a wood stove and electric heating. Ruffec is 12 minutes away, with shops and services nearby. Asking €71,000, about €676/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom house with river views and terrace in Brigueil-le-Chantre, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa lista para entrar, 2 dormitorios, vistas al río y terraza en Brigueil-le-Chantre, Vienne
homes.summary: Move-in ready house in good condition and recently renovated, with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The kitchen/diner, lounge and shower room are on the ground floor, with an office/TV room and master bedroom with en suite above. A small sunny terrace overlooks the river, and a large garage at street level offers storage and space for a small car. A wooded plot of land is a short walk away, close to the river. Heating is electric, and amenities are within 20 minutes. Asking €75,000, about €962/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house in good condition with fireplace and land in Le Vigeant, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios en buen estado con chimenea y terreno en Le Vigeant, Vienne
homes.summary: This house in good condition is habitable as is. It has 2 bedrooms, a separate fitted kitchen, a living room with a fireplace, a bathroom, a toilet and an attic bedroom. The property has a south-facing terrace, a garden side, 2,600 m² of land, a spring and a shed on adjoining land. Heating is electric, and the home is quiet and not overlooked, with 2 parking spaces. Asking €82,000, about €988/m².

homes.title: Period 3-bedroom village house with terraces and rooftop views in Caunes-Minervois, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 3 dormitorios con terrazas y vistas a los tejados en Caunes-Minervois, Languedoc
homes.summary: This characterful house of about 101 m2 has period features such as terracotta tiles, solid wood flooring and stone walls. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a separate toilet, plus an attic room usable as an office, workshop or guest bedroom. Two terraces include a rooftop terrace with unobstructed views over the rooftops. Heating is electric and aerothermal, and shops and restaurants are within walking distance. Asking €85,000, about €842/m².

homes.title: House with garden, barn and fireplace in Jaulnay, Indre-et-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa con jardín, granero y chimenea en Jaulnay, Indre-et-Loire
homes.summary: This village house of about 125 m2 is arranged over two levels. It has three bedrooms, a study area, a fitted kitchen, and one bathroom with a shower and bathtub. Two living areas totalling about 43 m2 include a central fireplace. Outside, there is a garden of about 900 m2, a 45 m2 barn, and a courtyard where a vehicle can be parked. Electric heating is installed, shops are within walking distance, and the A10 motorway and a TGV station are within 20 minutes. Asking €93,090, about €745/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom townhouse with attic and parking in Lisle, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa adosada lista para entrar a vivir de 3 dormitorios con ático y parking en Lisle, Dordogne
homes.summary: This move-in ready townhouse in the village of Lisle needs no work and can be lived in straight away. The ground floor has a bright living room, a fitted open-plan kitchen, a utility room of over 15 m², and a WC. Upstairs, three bedrooms include one over 19 m², alongside a dressing room and a shower room. The attic offers roof space with potential for conversion, and there are two parking spaces in front of the house. The home has oil-fired heating, double glazing and mains drainage. Asking €97,000, about €795/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and town views in Argenton-sur-Creuse, Indre
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y vistas al pueblo en Argenton-sur-Creuse, Indre
homes.summary: This house in Argenton-sur-Creuse is made of two connected houses with several possible uses. Living space includes an entrance room, two kitchens, two lounges, three bedrooms and two shower rooms, plus a large attic. Outside, there is a private garden with fruit trees, a courtyard terrace and views over the town. Extras include a fireplace, a large garage with cellar, and 11,410 sq ft of land. Asking €99,510, about €765/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom character house with cellar in Couiza, Aude
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter reformada de 2 dormitorios con sótano en Couiza, Aude
homes.summary: This renovated character house in Couiza offers 133 m2 of living space over three levels and is ready to live in. It includes a 20 m2 dining room, an open equipped kitchen of 18 m2, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a shower room. A 35 m2 cellar with outside access, double glazed wooden windows and parquet floors complete the home. The house has electric heating and east and west orientation. Asking €99,950, about €752/m².

homes.title: Family house with private garden and large outbuilding in Saint-Léomer, Poitou-Charentes
homes.title_es: Casa familiar con jardín privado y gran dependencia en Saint-Léomer, Poitou-Charentes
homes.summary: This family house in Saint-Léomer has a sunny aspect and large windows. Rooms include a dining room, a large living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms, a family bathroom, a downstairs WC and an attic. The plot covers 15,403 sq ft of land, with a private garden at the rear and a cellar. Across the road is a very large outbuilding with room to park cars, create a workshop and storage. It has oil-fired central heating and double glazing, Montmorillon is 10 minutes away and Poitiers airport is easily reached. Asking €104,500, about €731/m².

homes.title: Semi-detached 6-bedroom house with garden and land in Cirey-sur-Vezouze, Lorraine
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 6 dormitorios con jardín y parcela en Cirey-sur-Vezouze, Lorraine
homes.summary: Semi-detached house in Cirey-sur-Vezouze with a garden, set on a plot of 273 m². It offers a living area of 147.7 m² across 8 rooms, including 6 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The ground floor has a living room, dining room, kitchen, two bedrooms and a WC, while the first floor has four more bedrooms and a bathroom with WC. Heating is oil-fired central heating. Energy class E. Asking €105,000, about €709/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom country house with terrace and wood burner in Brigueil-le-Chantre, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de campo renovada de 3 dormitorios con terraza y estufa de leña en Brigueil-le-Chantre, Vienne
homes.summary: The renovated house is in good condition and ready to move into, with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The large fitted modern kitchen with island is open plan with the dining room and a wood burner. A separate large vaulted living room also has a wood burner. Outside are a sunny private terrace, a small garden with a shed and off-road parking by a large farm gate. The hamlet is close to Brigueil-le-Chantre, about 20 minutes from Montmorillon or Le Dorat. Asking €109,000, about €1,009/m².

homes.title: Two-dwelling stone house with barn and garden in Villars, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con dos viviendas, granero y jardín en Villars, Dordoña
homes.summary: This stone house in Villars is made up of two separate dwellings in a quiet small hamlet. The first dwelling has three bedrooms, a living room with an adjoining barn, a kitchen, a shower room and a toilet, while the second has one bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and a shower room. Features include a garden, enclosed courtyard, fireplace, cellar, attic, outbuildings, barn, a 1983 m2 plot, a garage and a parking space. It has oil-fired central heating and is close to Brantôme. Asking €119,800, about €749/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom character house with garden and fireplace in Étais-la-Sauvin, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de carácter renovada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y chimenea en Étais-la-Sauvin, Borgoña
homes.summary: This renovated character house in Étais-la-Sauvin needs no work and is ready to live in. It has 3 bedrooms, a 55 m² living room, a 12 m² kitchen and a 32 m² workshop. The 1,500 m² plot has a garden with fruit trees and a pond, plus a garage and a vaulted cellar. Features include a fireplace, a wood stove, exposed beams, mixed central heating with a wood insert and recent double glazing. Forests are a few minutes away by car, and Auxerre is 40 km away. Asking €120,000, about €659/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom house with garden and views in Lichères-sur-Yonne, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 4 dormitorios con jardín y vistas en Lichères-sur-Yonne, Borgoña
homes.summary: This renovated longère from the 1980s has a ground-floor entry, a kitchen and a dining room with a fireplace. Upstairs are 4 bedrooms, a dressing room and 1 bathroom, and the living room also has a fireplace. A large south-facing terrace raised above ground level offers unobstructed countryside views. A pleasant garden leads to an outbuilding with 2 closed garages, a workshop and a covered shelter. The 161 m2 home also has a small cellar and sits on 13,853 sq ft of land. Asking €120,000, about €745/m².

homes.title: Family house with garden, outbuildings and fireplaces in Villiers-Couture, Charente-Maritime
homes.title_es: Casa familiar con jardín, dependencias y chimeneas en Villiers-Couture, Charente-Maritime
homes.summary: This authentic family house of 259 m² stands in a hamlet in Villiers-Couture. It has 7 main rooms, including 5 bedrooms, a fitted kitchen and a 35 m² living room, both with open fireplaces. The entirely enclosed 802 m² plot includes a gravel courtyard surrounded by greenery, a garden, over 150 m² of outbuildings and a cellar. Oil central heating, individual sanitation, wooden shutters and a 35 m² convertible attic complete the house. Asking €137,000, about €529/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated four-bedroom house with balcony and garden in Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de cuatro dormitorios completamente renovada con balcón y jardín en Bergerac, Dordoña
homes.summary: A 150 m² stone house in Bergerac, on the Dordogne river, on a plot of about 270 m² and close to shops and services. The advert describes a total renovation with an energy rating of C and ducted reversible heating and cooling. Five rooms including four bedrooms, two bathrooms and three WCs, plus a balcony, a garden and two parking spaces. It is one of two lots in a small co-ownership with no running charges, as stated in the advert. Asking €139,000, about €927/m², which is low for a renovated house of this size in the Dordogne.

homes.title: Renovated period house with garden and double garage in Eauze, Gers
homes.title_es: Casa de época reformada con jardín y doble garaje en Eauze, Gers
homes.summary: This renovated period house stands in the heart of Eauze, Gers. It offers 210 m² of living space with a fitted kitchen with central island, a large 46 m² living room with a wood-burning insert, five bedrooms, a 7 m² office and two shower rooms. Outside there is a garden and a plot of 1,453 sq ft, plus a double garage with roller shutters and a workshop. Heating is provided by a pellet boiler, and the double glazing was installed in 2023. Asking €139,990, about €673/m².

homes.title: Stone farmhouse with garden, terrace and Pyrenees views in Marciac, Gers
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de piedra con jardín, terraza y vistas a los Pirineos en Marciac, Gers
homes.summary: This stone farmhouse offers 220 m² of living space across four rooms, including two bedrooms and one bathroom. The ground floor has a 27 m² kitchen with a fireplace and wood-burning stove, and a 44 m² living room with direct access to a south-facing terrace. The property includes a garden of about 2,600 m² with views of the Pyrenees, plus a 70 m² hangar and a chalet. Heating comes from two wood-burning stoves, and hot water from a gas-fired water heater. Marciac is 7 minutes away, and Tarbes airport and TGV station are 35 minutes away. Asking €144,000, about €655/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom former school house with garden and views in Genouillé, Vienne
homes.title_es: Antigua escuela totalmente renovada de 4 dormitorios con jardín y vistas en Genouillé, Vienne
homes.summary: This fully renovated former school in Genouillé has been converted into two connected homes. It has 6 rooms, 4 bedrooms, a shower room and 205 m2 of living space, including a bright studio. Outside there is a garden on 18,514 sq ft of land, plus an insulated garage and a parking space. The setting offers uninterrupted views of the surrounding area. Three heat pumps, double glazing and electric shutters are installed. Asking €148,950, about €727/m².

homes.title: Restored 3-bedroom farmhouse with garden and fireplace in Nanteuil-Auriac-de-Bourzac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de campo restaurada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y chimenea en Nanteuil-Auriac-de-Bourzac, Dordogne
homes.summary: Restored farmhouse of 209 m2 in a quiet hamlet, split into a 155 m2 main house and an attached 54 m2 cottage. The main house has 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a living room with a fireplace, a dining room and a kitchen. Outdoors there is a garden, a terrace, a plot of 541 m2 plus a separate 292 m2 plot, and an adjoining workshop. Heating is a wood stove, and the home is about twenty kilometers from Riberac. Asking €152,600, about €730/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom village house with roof terrace and views in Cruzy, Hérault
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 3 dormitorios totalmente reformada con terraza y vistas en Cruzy, Hérault
homes.summary: This fully renovated village house is move-in ready. It has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a lounge, a kitchen and a laundry room. Outdoors it offers a roof terrace of 27 m2 with views, a courtyard and a cellar or workshop. Heating comes from a wood burning stove and electric heating. Shops in the village are 25 minutes from Narbonne, 30 minutes from Béziers and 40 minutes from the beach. Asking €159,000, about €1,006/m².

homes.title: 66 m² flat with open views and a lift in Dijon
homes.title_es: Piso de 66 m² con vistas abiertas y ascensor en Dijon
homes.summary: 66 m² on the 4th floor of a residence with a lift: a large bright living room, a fitted kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, in good condition, with clear views. Close to trams, schools and shops; energy rating C. Asking €57,000, about €864/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom cottage with exposed beams in Brillac, Charente
homes.title_es: Cottage de 2 dormitorios listo para entrar a vivir con vigas vistas en Brillac, Charente
homes.summary: This move-in ready cottage sits in the heart of a village with amenities. It has a kitchen diner, a cosy living room with exposed beams, and two first-floor bedrooms looking across the village, with a WC and shower room. There is 624 sq ft of land but no garden, and fishing, walking and cycling spots are nearby. The house has electric heating and mains drainage, and Confolens is 10 minutes away. Asking €59,950, about €821/m².

homes.title: Bright south-west three-room flat with a lift in Le Havre
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones al suroeste con ascensor en Le Havre
homes.summary: 70 m² on the 5th floor with a lift in quiet Caucriauville: an 18 m² living room full of light, a separate 10 m² kitchen, two bedrooms with wardrobes and a bathroom. Freshly redone and empty; energy rating C. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €59,990, about €857/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Onlay, Nièvre
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y garaje en Onlay, Nièvre
homes.summary: This house in Onlay offers 102 m2 of living space across three bedrooms and two shower rooms. The 25 m2 living room has a wood stove, French beams and French doors onto the sunny terrace. The home has a 530 m2 garden, a garage, a cellar and oil-fired central heating. The spa village with all amenities is 10 km away. Asking €60,000, about €588/m².

homes.title: Renovated family house with garden and cellar in Clamecy, Nièvre, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa familiar reformada con jardín y sótano en Clamecy, Nièvre, Borgoña
homes.summary: This renovated house in Clamecy is move-in ready, with new windows and doors, updated decor and fresh paintwork. The ground floor has a bright living room, a separate kitchen with direct garden access and a WC, and upstairs are three bedrooms and a bathroom. Outdoors there is about 105 m2 of garden on a 180 m2 plot, facing east and west, plus a cellar of over 30 m2. Heating is electric, and shops, schools and the train station are nearby. Asking €79,000, about €681/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house with garden, fireplace and garages in Saint-Éloy-les-Mines, Auvergne
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios con jardín, chimenea y garajes en Saint-Éloy-les-Mines, Auvernia
homes.summary: This is a four-room house in Saint-Éloy-les-Mines, offering 90 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a large entrance hall, a fitted kitchen, a utility room, a separate toilet and a double living room with a fireplace. Upstairs there are two large bedrooms with storage and a shower room with toilet. The property has a tree-lined garden, 8,611 sq ft of land, outbuildings, cellars and garages, plus a conservatory. Gas-fired central heating is fitted, and the town's shops are close by. Asking €88,000, about €978/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom village house near river in Rupt-aux-Nonains, Meuse, Lorraine
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo reformada de 3 dormitorios junto al río en Rupt-aux-Nonains, Meuse, Lorena
homes.summary: This renovated village house offers a ground-floor kitchen, a living and dining room, and a utility and boiler room. Upstairs there are 3 bedrooms, a games room, a bathroom and a separate toilet. A river runs through the village, and the home is connected to the mains sewer system. Collective central heating is included, and the property has no garage or land. It sits in the Saulx Valley between Saint-Dizier and Ligny-en-Barrois, close to the RN4. Asking €88,000, about €854/m².

homes.title: Stone country house with garden and outbuildings in Marmande, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de piedra con jardín y dependencias en Marmande, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: Stone country house a few minutes from Marmande, with stone walls under the render and a calm setting. The ground floor has an entrance, a separate kitchen and a bright lounge opening onto a gallery, while upstairs there are two bedrooms of over 20 m² each and an office. The enclosed plot of about 3,000 m² includes a garden with fruit trees, outbuildings, a well, a garage and parking spaces. Wood heating, 105 m² of living space and an extension of about 60 m² is possible upstairs. Asking €89,500, about €852/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house in good condition with garden and conservatory in Ploërdut, Morbihan, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios en buen estado con jardín y veranda en Ploërdut, Morbihan, Bretaña
homes.summary: This 2-bedroom house in good condition offers 103 m² of living space in Ploërdut. Downstairs there are an entrance, kitchen, lounge, utility room, WC and conservatory, and upstairs two bedrooms and a shower room with WC. The enclosed garden has its own well, the plot totals 274 m² of land, and a large attic offers potential for more living space. The house has double glazing, oil central heating and a woodburner. It is 8 minutes' drive from Guémené-sur-Scorff, 20 minutes from Rostrenen and about 45 minutes from the South Coast. Asking €91,120, about €885/m².

homes.title: Townhouse with commercial space, three suites and terrace in Ruffec, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa adosada con local comercial, tres apartamentos y terraza en Ruffec, Charente
homes.summary: Townhouse on Ruffec's main square with a ground-floor commercial space of about 24 sqm, a shop window, WC and kitchen. Upstairs are three independent suites, including a 41 sqm suite with shower room, WC and private terrace. Features include a cellar, 549 sq ft of land and views of the town. Double glazing, electric heating and mains drainage with shops and the covered market steps away and Poitiers and Limoges airports under 45 minutes. Asking €99,900, about €787/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom house with terrace and fireplace in Ourjout, Ariège
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios con terraza y chimenea en Ourjout, Ariège
homes.summary: This three-level house in the village of Ourjout has four or five bedrooms and 145 sq m of living space. It includes a 34 sq m living room, a 23 sq m kitchen, two bathrooms and three toilets. Outdoor features include a 25 sq m covered area, a terrace, a fireplace and one parking space. It has double glazing and electric heating from convectors. Castillon en Couserans, the canton's main town, is 3 km away. Asking €108,000, about €745/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Frévent, Pas-de-Calais
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Frévent, Pas-de-Calais
homes.summary: Renovated 3-bedroom house of 124 m² in a quiet area close to conveniences. Ground floor with entrance hall, living and dining room with pellet stove, equipped kitchen and bathroom with walk-in shower. Upstairs there is a master bedroom, two further bedrooms, an office and a toilet, plus a large attic and cellar. Outside there is a garden, a courtyard for two cars, a garage workshop and 2,433 sq ft of land. Heating comes from a pellet stove and electric heating. Asking €116,000, about €935/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and land in Fénery, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y terreno en Fénery, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: This renovated semi-detached house offers 135 m² of living space across five rooms, including three bedrooms. The bright living room measures 30 m² and has double-glazed PVC windows. A separate kitchen is fitted, and the house has separate toilets, a shower room and a cellar. The fully enclosed plot of 5.05 acres includes a garden and an attic for storage. Heating comes from wood heating and an individual heating system, and shops, schools and medical facilities are within a 15-minute drive. Asking €116,850, about €866/m².

homes.title: Character 2-bedroom house with south-facing terrace and garden in Fréville, Vosges
homes.title_es: Casa con encanto de 2 dormitorios con terraza orientada al sur y jardín en Fréville, Vosges
homes.summary: This character house in Fréville has authentic traditional style and a warm atmosphere. It includes a spacious kitchen opening onto a south-facing terrace, plus a dining room, living room and shower room. Upstairs, a mezzanine leads to two large bedrooms and a bathroom with shower and toilet. Outside you will find a garden, a garage, a garden shed and a plot of land. The house has wood heating and sits near Neufchâteau. Asking €119,000, about €768/m².

homes.title: Restored 3-bedroom stone house with fireplace and garage in Lacapelle-Biron, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios restaurada con chimenea y garaje en Lacapelle-Biron, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This restored stone house on three levels was fully restored in 2003 and is in excellent condition. It has three bedrooms, a living room with an inset fireplace, a fitted kitchen, a first-floor living room with a fireplace opening onto a veranda, two shower rooms and a WC. A fully tiled garage, a tiled attic of 33 sq m and 1,044 sq ft of land complete the property. Electric heating is installed. Asking €121,700, about €901/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with terrace and garage in Tonneins, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con terraza y garaje en Tonneins, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This renovated three-bedroom house is ready to move into. The ground floor has a lounge, a large recently fitted kitchen, a shower room, a toilet, a laundry room and a garage over 30 m². The second floor has two spacious bedrooms, a room that could be a dressing room and an attic. Outdoors there is a terrace, 2,368 sq ft of land and a fireplace with a wood-burning insert. The home has mains gas heating, and the town centre, shops and railway station are close by. Asking €127,000, about €858/m².

homes.title: Well maintained 4-bedroom house with garden and lake access in Callac, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios bien mantenida con jardín y acceso al lago en Callac, Bretaña
homes.summary: This well maintained detached house offers 115 m² of living space over a full basement. It has four bedrooms upstairs, each with storage, plus a bathroom and a separate toilet. The ground floor includes a fitted kitchen, a living room, a dining area and an office. The 2,500 m² plot includes a garden with open countryside views and direct access to the lake and walking trails. An existing fireplace with insert, oil-fired heating and two parking spaces complete the home, and shops and services are a 10-minute walk away. Asking €129,000, about €1,122/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and cellar in Martinvelle, Vosges, Lorraine
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y sótano en Martinvelle, Vosges, Lorena
homes.summary: Independent house of 193 square metres on a fenced, planted plot of 497 square metres. Ground floor has a bright living room with Vosges limestone slabs, a fireplace with wood-burning stove, a fitted kitchen and a study, plus 3 bedrooms upstairs. Extra features include a garden, a terrace, a garage, a vaulted cellar and an attic. Heating is oil-fired central heating, and the village is close to all amenities. Asking €129,000, about €668/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready house with two apartments and courtyard in Saint-Martory, Haute-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa lista para entrar a vivir con dos viviendas y patio en Saint-Martory, Haute-Garonne
homes.summary: This move-in ready house in Saint-Martory comprises two apartments of 85 m2 and 95 m2 linked by an inner courtyard. It offers 7 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 1 shower room and an equipped kitchen across 200 m2 of living space. The windows are double-glazed PVC, the roof is in good condition, and the building has two separate water meters and mains drainage. Both apartments are vacant at purchase and the energy rating is E. Asking €139,000, about €695/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y garaje en Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.summary: This 201 m2 house has four bedrooms and a 73 m2 living room overlooked by a mezzanine. It also has a separate equipped kitchen, a shower room and a ground floor room that could be an office. Outdoor features include a garden, a covered terrace and a private courtyard. A garage, two parking spaces and 54,358 sq ft of land complete the plot. Electric heating is fitted, and the village of Nanteuil-en-Vallée is a 10-minute drive away. Asking €147,970, about €736/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom manor house with garden, terrace and outbuilding in Durance, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casona con 4 dormitorios, jardín, terraza y dependencia en Durance, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This manor house in Durance offers 307 m2 of living space and four bedrooms. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a study, a large lounge, a living room, a kitchen, a rear kitchen and a toilet. Upstairs, four bedrooms, two bathrooms and an additional room share the first floor with a separate toilet. Outside, a 4,900 m2 tree-filled park has a garden, a terrace and a separate outbuilding, on a plot of 52,743 sq ft. The home has oil-fired central heating and one parking space. Asking €149,800, about €488/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom stone house with pool and views in Allonne, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada de 4 dormitorios con piscina y vistas en Allonne, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: Renovated traditional stone house in a quiet hamlet, with a terrace, a swimming pool and just over 700 m2 of land. Inside there are seven rooms, including four bedrooms, two shower rooms and a 43 m2 living room downstairs. The pool has unobstructed countryside views, and recent work covers the roof, septic tank, double glazing and shutters. Heating comes from an oil-fired boiler and a wood-burning stove. Secondigny is 5 minutes away, Parthenay 15 minutes and Niort 35 minutes. Asking €176,800, about €940/m².

homes.title: Renovated two-room flat for €39,000 in Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Piso de dos habitaciones reformado por 39.000 € en Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: 45 m² on the ground floor of a small building (7 lots) on rue Dufour, Carnot: a through living room, a new fitted kitchen, a bedroom with its own shower room and a separate WC. Double glazing and low charges (€703 a year). Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €39,000, about €867/m².

homes.title: Hilltop village house with a sunny terrace in Bourmont
homes.title_es: Casa en lo alto de un pueblo histórico, con terraza soleada, en Bourmont
homes.summary: On the heights of the historic village of Bourmont, in Haute-Marne: a fitted kitchen, a large living room with a fireplace, a balcony and a big fenced south-east terrace, two large bedrooms, an office and a dressing room, plus a garage.

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with cellars, garage and terrace in Lormes, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con sótanos, garaje y terraza en Lormes, Borgoña
homes.summary: This house is raised partly on two cellars. The ground floor has an entrance, a kitchen, a living room, a dining room, a WC and a garage. The first floor has a large landing serving three bedrooms, a WC, a shower room and a bathroom. Outside, there is a small terrace in front of the house, and one parking space is listed. It has electric heating and is oriented north and south, with risk information available on the Géorisques site. Asking €59,400, about €571/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom townhouse with cellar and clear views in Lacaune, Tarn
homes.title_es: Casa adosada reformada de 3 dormitorios con sótano y vistas despejadas en Lacaune, Tarn
homes.summary: This renovated townhouse is built over a cellar and set on two levels in a quiet street in Lacaune. The bright kitchen opens to a living room with a wood stove, and upstairs are three bedrooms and a bathroom with toilet. It has clear views but no land, and is joined to a neighbouring house on one side. Heating is by wood stove and electric radiant panels, with hot water from an electric cylinder. Shops, a nursery and a secondary school are nearby, Castres is 40 minutes away and Béziers 1 hour 40 minutes. Asking €85,000, about €1,012/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom stone house with garden, terrace and plot in Joussé, Vienne, Poitou-Charentes
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y parcela en Joussé, Vienne, Poitou-Charentes
homes.summary: This stone house was created from two adjoining houses just outside the village of Joussé. It has a kitchen-diner with a wood-burning stove, a separate lounge with exposed stone walls, beams and a second wood stove, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. Outside are a courtyard, a terrace, a front garden, a plot of land and parking with a double gate. Outbuildings include a workshop and a wood store, and heating is electric. The village bakery is 1 km away, and a lake lies in the surrounding area. Asking €95,000, about €1,145/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom house with garden and terrace in Saint-Pierre-Bellevue, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa lista para entrar a vivir de 2 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en Saint-Pierre-Bellevue, Creuse
homes.summary: This move-in ready house needs no work and can be lived in now. It has two bedrooms, a bathroom, a separate toilet, an equipped kitchen with dining area and a living/dining room. Outdoor features include a 30 m² terrace with barbecue, a garden around the house and a 510 m² plot. Features include a fireplace with an insert, a cellar, a garage, a detached 30 m² garage and a wood shelter. It is double glazed, connected to mains drainage and 10 km from Lake Vassivière. Asking €99,000, about €1,222/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom village house with fireplace in Lacombe, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo totalmente reformada de 3 dormitorios con chimenea en Lacombe, Languedoc
homes.summary: This fully renovated village house in Lacombe provides 85 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a living area with a kitchen space, the first floor has two bedrooms and a shower room, and the attic on the second floor could be a third bedroom, office or leisure room. It has a fireplace and wood-burning stove, exposed stone, wooden floors and beams. The lakes of Galaube, Lampy and Laprade are a few minutes away, and the house is on mains drainage with fibre-optic broadband. Asking €99,000, about €1,165/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom village house with fireplace and cellar in La Bastide-de-Besplas, Ariège
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada de 2 dormitorios con chimenea y sótano en La Bastide-de-Besplas, Ariège
homes.summary: This renovated house in the village of La Bastide-de-Besplas is move-in ready, with 102 m² of living space. On the first floor there are two bedrooms, a shower room and a WC, plus a mezzanine that can also be a bedroom and a roof-space office. The ground floor has a fitted kitchen, a living room with a fireplace insert, a spacious lounge and a cellar. The house has double glazing and electric heating. The village has shops and local services, and Toulouse is 35 minutes away. Asking €99,510, about €976/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom village house with river views and outbuilding in Pressac, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios en pueblo con vistas al río y dependencia en Pressac, Vienne
homes.summary: This three-bedroom house sits in the heart of a village in Pressac, just moments from the river. The ground floor has a kitchen/dining room, a lounge, a study and a storage room used as a utility space, while upstairs you'll find three bedrooms, a bathroom with shower and a separate WC. The bedrooms have river views, and the property includes a front courtyard, a substantial outbuilding and 2,164 sq ft of land. Heating comes from wood burners and wall-mounted electric heaters. Asking €99,950, about €970/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom stone house with cellar in Limoux, Aude
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada de 3 dormitorios con bodega en Limoux, Aude
homes.summary: This renovated stone house on two levels sits in a village about 10 minutes from Limoux. The ground floor has a 53 m2 living room, lounge and kitchen, plus a shower room with WC. The first floor has a large landing, two bedrooms (14 m2 and 12 m2, the latter with a 4 m2 mezzanine) and a shower room with WC. The second floor has a 17 m2 bedroom and a 7 m2 attic or storage room. A detached cellar with a 30 m2 room lies 50 m from the house. Features include wood heating and a south orientation, and Limoux with its shops is about 10 minutes away. Asking €108,000, about €923/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom country house with fireplace, land and outbuildings in Mautes, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de 2 dormitorios con chimenea, terreno y dependencias en Mautes, Creuse
homes.summary: This country house has two bedrooms and 137 m² of living space. The ground floor holds a kitchen with dining room of 35 m², a 31 m² living room, a boiler room and a WC, while upstairs there is a hallway, a mezzanine and a shower room. The land includes 576 m² attached and 183 m² detached, plus an outbuilding on two levels, an old bread oven opposite the house and a fireplace. It has oil-fired central heating. Asking €110,000, about €803/m².

homes.title: House with courtyard terrace, pool and open fireplace in Aigre, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa con patio y terraza, piscina y chimenea abierta en Aigre, Charente
homes.summary: This 104 m2 house has three bedrooms and a bathroom on the first floor. The spacious living room is filled with natural light and has an open fireplace, with central oil-fired heating. The house has a private courtyard with a terrace and a small garden, and there is a private parking space. It is part of a small co-ownership of five houses that shares a secure in-ground swimming pool, a garden and a converted barn with a games room. Asking €110,000, about €1,058/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with garden and countryside views in La Salvetat-Peyralès, Aveyron
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada con jardín y vistas al campo en La Salvetat-Peyralès, Aveyron
homes.summary: This renovated stone house sits in a peaceful hamlet near La Salvetat-Peyralès, Aveyron. Inside, an open-plan living and dining area with a wood-burning stove opens to a modern kitchen, and there are two double bedrooms, one en-suite, plus a study or third bedroom. Outside, there is a private garden 100 m from the house with panoramic countryside views and 10,183 sq ft of land. Heating is wood, with a bakery, grocery and school within cycling distance and Rodez-Marcillac Airport 50 minutes away. Asking €115,000, about €991/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom old house with fireplace and garage in Saint-Porchaire, Charente-Maritime
homes.title_es: Casa antigua de 4 dormitorios con chimenea y garaje en Saint-Porchaire, Charente-Maritime
homes.summary: This old house in Saint-Porchaire has four bedrooms, high ceilings and large rooms. The ground floor has a hallway, a living room with a south-facing fireplace and a large kitchen with a back kitchen and direct access to an about 15 m2 garage. Upstairs there are four bedrooms, a shower room and a laundry room, and the top floor has a convertible 74 m2 attic. Several parking spaces are nearby, and there is no garden. Oil-fired central heating is installed, and Saintes is 15 minutes away. Asking €117,167, about €862/m².

homes.title: Bright 3-bedroom house in good condition with garage in Limoux, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa luminosa de 3 dormitorios en buen estado con garaje en Limoux, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This house in good condition sits in the city centre of Limoux. The first floor has an open-plan kitchen and dining room, a bright living room and a large storage room. The second floor offers two bedrooms, a dressing room, a bathroom and a separate toilet, while the third floor has a 17 m2 space for a bedroom, office or workshop. A 40 m2 garage and gas-fired central heating complete the home. Asking €119,840, about €959/m².

homes.title: Spacious 4-bedroom house with fireplace, garage and views in Simorre, Gers
homes.title_es: Amplia casa de 4 dormitorios con chimenea, garaje y vistas en Simorre, Gers
homes.summary: This large house suits a large family and could be divided into two separate apartments. It has four bedrooms, a lounge with kitchen corner, a living room with fireplace and kitchen area, a shower room and separate toilets. Extra features include a garage with toilet and views over the plain. Heating is by wood stove, with water connection, sewage, a telephone line and a gas bottle. It is in the centre of a small village in the department of Gers. Asking €123,000, about €794/m².

homes.title: Bungalow with veranda and garden in Saint-Vite, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Bungaló con galería y jardín en Saint-Vite, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: The bungalow is in very good condition, with good insulation. It covers about 104 m2 with three bedrooms, a bathroom with bath and shower, and a separate toilet. The living and dining room has air conditioning and a fireplace, and the kitchen opens onto a veranda. A tiled terrace and a closed garden of 575 m2 with a well sit outside. It has double glazed windows and central gas heating, in a quiet area near all shops. Asking €123,000, about €1,183/m².

homes.title: Character 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and cellar in Autun, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa con encanto de 4 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y bodega en Autun, Borgoña
homes.summary: Character house with origins in the 17th century, partly built on a vaulted cellar in a peripheral district of Autun. It has a 29 m² living room with fireplace, a 13.50 m² kitchen, a 15.50 m² dining room and two ground floor bedrooms, plus a bathroom and WC. The upper floor has two bedrooms of 22 and 30 m². The fully enclosed 1,470 m² plot has a garden, orchard, vegetable garden, well, covered terrace, garage and hen house. Central heating runs on fuel with cast iron radiators. Asking €127,000, about €765/m².

homes.title: Stone 4-bedroom house with fireplace and shops within walking distance in Eymet, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 4 dormitorios con chimenea y tiendas a pie en Eymet, Dordogne
homes.summary: This stone house in Eymet has four bedrooms and 165 m2 of living space over six rooms. The 45 m2 living room has a fireplace, and there is a separate fitted kitchen, two bedrooms on the ground floor and two upstairs. Each floor has a shower room and toilet, and the home has double glazing, wooden shutters and a south orientation. A parking space is included, and schools, shops and doctors are within walking distance. The house is about 30 minutes from Bergerac. Asking €127,500, about €773/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom stone house with garden and hangar in Chalvraines, Haute-Marne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y nave en Chalvraines, Haute-Marne
homes.summary: Move-in ready stone house in a quiet village, with four bedrooms. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a living room, a lounge, a kitchen with direct garden access, and a bedroom with en-suite bathroom and WC. Upstairs there are three bedrooms, a dressing room, a shower room, a separate WC and two attics. The 1,633 m2 plot includes a garden, a basement cellar and a hangar of about 167 m2 at the end of the garden. Heating is oil-fired central heating with a pellet stove, and the windows are double-glazed. Asking €129,800, about €750/m².

homes.title: House with 7 bedrooms, garden and land in Dracy-Saint-Loup, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de 7 dormitorios con jardín y terreno en Dracy-Saint-Loup, Borgoña
homes.summary: House of 265 m² with 7 bedrooms and one bathroom, set on a plot of 860 m² in Dracy-Saint-Loup. The main house has 7 rooms and 4 bedrooms, with a 46 m² living room, and a secondary house has 3 rooms, 2 bedrooms and a 25 m² living room. Outdoor space includes a 500 m² garden at the back, a 100 m² courtyard at the front and a parking space. Heating is gas-fired central heating in the main house and electric heating in the secondary house. Asking €142,000, about €536/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom house with land, stone barn and views in Civray, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con terreno, granero de piedra y vistas en Civray, Vienne
homes.summary: This move-in ready house is in good structural condition and ready to move into. It has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 5 rooms and an equipped kitchen. Outside, the plot of 19,375 sq ft of land includes a detached stone barn and lovely views over tranquil countryside. The home also has a cellar, a large loft with its own internal staircase, and two wood burning stoves plus a fireplace. Oil-fired central heating is installed, and the house is minutes from local towns between Ruffec and Civray. Asking €148,950, about €961/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom stone house with covered terrace and garden in Piégut-Pluviers, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 4 dormitorios con terraza cubierta y jardín en Piégut-Pluviers, Dordogne
homes.summary: This 161 m2 stone house sits in a peaceful hamlet in the North Dordogne. It has four bedrooms, two bathrooms and an open-plan kitchen, living and dining room, with patio doors leading to a large covered terrace. Outside there is an enclosed garden, an attached garage and 6,781 sq ft of land. Electric heating is installed. It lies 3.5 km from Piégut-Pluviers and 5 km from Lac de Saint-Estèphe, a lake offering swimming. Asking €159,000, about €988/m².

homes.title: Characterful 4-bedroom house with pool and views in Beaulieu-sur-Sonnette, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter de 4 dormitorios con piscina y vistas en Beaulieu-sur-Sonnette, Charente
homes.summary: This is a characterful old four-bedroom house in a hilly village in Charente, Poitou-Charentes. It offers 199 m² of living space across 7 rooms, including 4 bedrooms and 1 shower room, plus a fitted kitchen. The 8,708 sq ft plot has a swimming pool, a garage, a parking space and views over the surrounding countryside. The house has oil-fired central heating and a separate equipped kitchen. Asking €159,575, about €802/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom farmhouse with garden and countryside views in Le Busseau, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa de campo renovada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y vistas al campo en Le Busseau, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: This renovated farmhouse is in good condition and ready to be personalized. It offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a kitchen, a living and dining room with exposed stone and beams, and a lounge with a pellet stove. Outdoors there is a garden with a well, about 2,200 m2 of land facing south, countryside views, a carport and a workshop outbuilding. Double glazing, 3 kW solar panels and an electric water heater are included. The home is 10 minutes from Coulonges-sur-l'Autize and 35 minutes from Niort. Asking €166,400, about €979/m².

homes.title: Four-bedroom house with garden, garage and views in Mussidan, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de cuatro dormitorios con jardín, garaje y vistas en Mussidan, Dordogne
homes.summary: This 1970s house stands at the end of a dead-end street, built on a semi-underground basement. It offers 7 rooms, including 4 bedrooms and 2 shower rooms, across 166 m² of living space. The living-dining room has a balcony with a lovely view, and there is a fireplace. Outside, a fenced, tree-lined plot of 1,201 m² includes a garden and a garden shed of about 20 m². An attached garage of 27 m² adds parking, and the house has electric heating. Asking €169,000, about €1,018/m².

homes.title: Spacious 4-bedroom stone house with barn and garden in Villemain, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa espaciosa de 4 dormitorios de piedra con granero y jardín en Villemain, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: The house has 198 m2 of living space, four bedrooms and two large reception rooms, with a fitted kitchen and a laundry room. It is double glazed and heated by oil-fired central heating, and the structure and exterior are in good condition. Outside there is an enclosed garden, an enclosed courtyard for parking and a 40 m2 barn with concrete floor. The market town of Chef Boutonne is a 10 minute drive away, and Niort, Poitiers and Angoulême are 45 minutes away. Asking €179,990, about €909/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 1700s stone village house of 180 m² near La Rochefoucauld, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de piedra de los años 1700 lista para entrar de 180 m² cerca de La Rochefoucauld, Charente
homes.summary: About 180 m² of old stone house for €189,000, roughly €1,050 per m², and the advert says it is ready to move into. The ground floor has three rooms of over 30 m² each: a living room, a large beamed kitchen and a bedroom with its own bathroom, so you can live on one level. Upstairs are a 34 m² bedroom with a private bathroom, a 23 m² office, a mezzanine and a terrace. Exposed stone, old beams and stoves. Small easy garden, carport and workshop. The village is 5 km from La Rochefoucauld and 30 km from Angoulême TGV station. Energy rating D.

homes.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom terraced house with terrace and land in Lormes, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa adosada totalmente reformada de 4 dormitorios con terraza y terreno en Lormes, Borgoña
homes.summary: This fully renovated terraced house in the centre of Lormes is move-in ready with no work expected. It has 83 m2 of living space, five rooms and four bedrooms, plus one shower room. The property has a small composite terrace at the rear, a land plot of 1,152 sq ft, and a storage building with a basement and attic. Heating is electric and the orientation is east and west. Shops are close by. Asking €63,000, about €759/m².

homes.title: Character house with panoramic views in Treignac
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter y vistas panorámicas en Treignac
homes.summary: A character house of about 88 m² in Treignac, one of the 'most beautiful villages' of the Corrèze, close enough to walk to the shops, with panoramic views over the valley. A 25 m² living room with fireplace and wood stove, two bedrooms under the beams and a modern shower room. No garden to look after.

homes.title: Village house with 3 bedrooms, office and attic in Quillan, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo con 3 dormitorios, despacho y desván en Quillan, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: Village house in the centre of Quillan with character, arranged over several levels. The ground floor has a fitted kitchen, living room and dining room of 25.87 m². The first floor has a 14.12 m² bedroom and a bathroom with WC of 5.75 m². The second floor has a 16.28 m² bedroom and an 8.06 m² office, plus a 17 m² attic. The roof is in good condition, and the home has electric heating. Asking €69,000, about €986/m².

homes.title: Stone house in good condition with 2 bedrooms in Périgueux, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra en buen estado con 2 dormitorios en Périgueux, Dordogne
homes.summary: This stone house in good condition is located in the centre of Périgueux. The ground floor has a main room with a kitchen and a toilet, the first floor has a landing, a bedroom and a shower room, and the second floor has a bedroom, a bathroom and an additional room. It has two bedrooms, a living area of 77 m² and no garden. It is suited to a first purchase or to investors wishing to create flats. Asking €70,000, about €909/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom village house with garden and terrace in Montfranc, Aveyron
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 3 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en Montfranc, Aveyron
homes.summary: This village house stands on a fenced plot in Montfranc, Aveyron, with 70 m2 of living space. Inside, an entrance hall leads to a living room with fireplace and insert, a kitchenette, three bedrooms and a shower room with WC. Outdoor features include a garden, a large terrace and land, plus a garage with a parking space and a cellar reached through the living room. The home has wood heating and sits about 45 minutes from Albi. Asking €75,000, about €1,071/m².

homes.title: Two-bedroom village house with large garden and double garage in Jouac, Limousin
homes.title_es: Casa de dos dormitorios en pueblo con jardín grande y garaje doble en Jouac, Limousin
homes.summary: This house in the village of Jouac has 77 m2 of living space, two bedrooms and one bathroom. The living room has two large windows and a wood-burning stove, and the kitchen gives access to the garden. Outdoor features include a large L-shaped garden, a rear terrace, a double garage and 14,111 sq ft of land. Heating is oil-fired central heating, and the house is connected to mains drainage. Asking €80,000, about €1,039/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom stone house with garden and terrace in Chalvraines, Haute-Marne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios lista para habitar con jardín y terraza en Chalvraines, Haute-Marne
homes.summary: Move-in ready stone house in Chalvraines, in excellent condition and fully decorated. It has three bedrooms, two on the first floor and a third under the roofs that can be set up as an office or guest room, plus a living room with a fitted kitchen and a shower room with separate WC. Outside there is a recently fenced garden with a terrace, a vaulted cellar, a stone outbuilding and a parking space at the front. The house has a fireplace and wood heating. Asking €81,700, about €996/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom stone house with garden and terrace in L'Absie, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada de 2 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en L'Absie, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: Renovated stone house in a village, ready to move in. The ground floor has a bright living room with a pellet burner, a toilet, and a fitted kitchen. Upstairs are two parquet bedrooms and a shower room with WC. The south facing home has a front courtyard with a well, a rear garden, a terrace, and a workshop of about 20 m2 on 5,920 sq ft of land. Recent works include insulation, heating and rewiring, with Niort, Parthenay and Bressuire about 30 minutes away. Asking €84,000, about €988/m².

homes.title: Well maintained 4-bedroom house with garden and covered terrace in Pineuilh, Gironde
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios bien mantenida con jardín y terraza cubierta en Pineuilh, Gironda
homes.summary: This well maintained house has four bedrooms spread over two floors. The ground floor has a living room, a kitchen, a brand-new shower room and a separate WC, with a conservatory adjoining the kitchen. Outside you will find a garden of about 230 m2, a covered terrace and space to park one vehicle. The home has gas-fired central heating, with the boiler replaced one year ago, and new mechanical ventilation. Asking €97,000, about €1,032/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom house with garden and terrace in Saint-Sulpice-Laurière, Limousin
homes.title_es: Casa lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y terraza en Saint-Sulpice-Laurière, Limousin
homes.summary: This move-in ready detached house, built in 1945, is well maintained and in good condition. It offers 3 bedrooms, a living room, a separate kitchen and 1 bathroom over 83 m2 of living space. Outside there is a private garden, a terrace, indoor and outdoor parking and 22,593 sq ft of land. Heating is oil-fired central heating, and the house is connected to the main sewer. It sits in a quiet residential area close to local amenities. Asking €98,000, about €1,181/m².

homes.title: Two-bedroom cottage with garden down to the river in Ségur-le-Château, Corrèze
homes.title_es: Casita de dos dormitorios con jardín hasta el río en Ségur-le-Château, Corrèze
homes.summary: This two-bedroom cottage is all on one level and sits in a tranquil location within walking distance of the village centre. Its 88 m2 interior has an entrance hall, kitchen, lounge, shower room with toilet and two bedrooms. Outside there is a good sized garden running down to the river, a stone outbuilding with a sun terrace above, and a single garage. The land totals 20,322 sq ft, with electric heating and mains drains. Asking €99,000, about €1,125/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom village house with garden and views in Davejean, Aude
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y vistas en Davejean, Aude
homes.summary: Renovated village house with three bedrooms and two bathrooms, arranged over three floors across 80 m2. Outdoor space includes a garden, a roof terrace with views over wooded slopes, a balcony and a 2,583 sq ft plot. Two adjacent barns are included in the sale for storage. Heating comes from electric wall heaters and a wood burning stove, and most windows are double glazed. The village is about an hour from Carcassonne, Narbonne and Perpignan.
