Asking €99,000, about €1,238/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom farmhouse with swimming pool and garden in Chailley, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de 2 dormitorios con piscina y jardín en Chailley, Borgoña
homes.summary: This farmhouse in the peaceful hamlet of Chailley has two bedrooms and original features such as exposed beams, timber framing and half-timbering. The ground floor has a fitted kitchen, a living room with an inset fireplace, a dining room, a utility room and a separate WC. Upstairs, a landing leads to two bedrooms and a shower room with WC. Outside, the 515 sq m garden includes a swimming pool, and the property has 5,543 sq ft of land. Asking €99,000, about €925/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom cottage with garden and countryside views in Tilly, Indre
homes.title_es: Casa de campo lista para entrar a vivir de 3 dormitorios con jardín y vistas al campo en Tilly, Indre
homes.summary: This move-in ready cottage sits in a peaceful hamlet with modern, spacious living. It has three bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, a large living room and a family dining room. Outside there is a lovely garden with countryside views, parking, and an outbuilding with a garage. Heating comes from electric heating and wood-burning stoves. Chaillac is 6 km away and Limoges International Airport is less than an hour away. Asking €108,900, about €1,027/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and outbuildings in Haut-Bocage, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 4 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y dependencias en Haut-Bocage, Allier
homes.summary: This renovated house has a single-storey living room with a fireplace, a fitted kitchen and one bedroom. The first floor holds three more bedrooms, a shower room and separate toilets, giving 105 m2 of living space and 5 rooms. Outdoor features include a fenced garden, a terrace, outbuildings and garage access via the patio. The property also includes 5,920 sq ft of land. Asking €110,000, about €1,048/m².

homes.title: House with garden, orchard and terrace in Martinvelle, Vosges
homes.title_es: Casa con jardín, huerto y terraza en Martinvelle, Vosgos
homes.summary: This village house offers 136 m² across six rooms, with four bedrooms and one bathroom. The ground floor has a fitted kitchen, a living room with terrace access and a pellet stove, plus a WC and storeroom. Upstairs, three bedrooms include one with a dressing room. Features include a garden, an orchard, a terrace, a covered terrace, a cellar, an attic or mezzanine and a garage, on a flat 3,650 m² plot. Heating is electric plus a pellet stove. Asking €110,000, about €809/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom house with balcony and land in Sainte-Foy-la-Grande, Gironde
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 4 dormitorios con balcón y terreno en Sainte-Foy-la-Grande, Gironda
homes.summary: This renovated house stands in the heart of a bastide in Sainte-Foy-la-Grande, offering 109 m² of living space. The ground floor has an entrance hall, an equipped kitchen/dining room, a bright living room and a bathroom. Upstairs are two bedrooms, a dressing area and a shower room with WC, plus three second-floor rooms, two of them bedrooms. Features include a balcony and 635 sq ft of land, with gas-fired central heating connected to mains gas. Schools and local amenities are nearby. Asking €113,000, about €1,037/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom period house with beams and balcony in Labastide-d'Armagnac, Landes
homes.title_es: Casa de época reformada de 2 dormitorios con vigas y balcón en Labastide-d'Armagnac, Landes
homes.summary: Renovated period house of about 101 m² with two bedrooms, one opening onto a balcony. The ground floor has a 27.5 m² dining room, an open-plan kitchen, a separate 16.5 m² living room, a utility room and a shower room. Upstairs there is a 7.5 m² study, a second WC and an attic suitable for conversion. The roof has been renovated, and heating is electric and pellet with mains drainage. The village has shops, services, restaurants and a weekly market. Asking €114,000, about €1,129/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom village house with garden and terrace in Treignac, Corrèze
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada de 2 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en Treignac, Corrèze
homes.summary: This renovated village house dates from 1650 and stands on a quiet street in Treignac. It has 101 m2 of living space, two bedrooms, and a sunny living room of 47 m2 with a fireplace. A guest room has a private shower room, and the master suite has exposed beams. Outside, a courtyard of 27 m2 has a terrace and storage shed, with a garden and land of 291 sq ft. Heating is electric and the village has all commodities on hand. Asking €114,450, about €1,133/m².

homes.title: 5-bedroom village house with land and balcony in Espéraza, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 5 dormitorios con terreno y balcón en Espéraza, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This village house in Espéraza offers 130 m2 of living space over three floors. The ground floor has a 29.82 m2 living room and a 13.13 m2 fitted kitchen, and the upper floors hold five bedrooms and two shower rooms. A small balcony serves the first floor, and three non-adjoining plots of 1,490, 1,880 and 2,435 m2 are scattered across the commune, all uncultivated and unbuildable. The house has collective central heating and is five minutes from the town of Espéraza and its shops. Asking €114,500, about €881/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom house with garden, garage and land in Fourmies, Nord
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con jardín, garaje y terreno en Fourmies, Nord
homes.summary: Move-in ready semi-detached house in Fourmies with neutral decor. The ground floor has a hallway, living room, kitchen with direct access to the rear courtyard, a shower room and a separate toilet. Upstairs are three bedrooms and a connecting room that can be used as an office, dressing room or storage. Features include a garden, a cellar, and an off-site plot about 20 metres away with a garage. Heating is by heat pump, with PVC double-glazed windows, and shops are close by in the town centre. Asking €116,600, about €1,032/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom farmhouse with garden and fireplace in Adriers, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de campo renovada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y chimenea en Adriers, Vienne
homes.summary: This renovated farmhouse stands in a quiet hamlet close to Adriers. It offers three bedrooms, including a large downstairs bedroom with a modern shower room, plus a separate WC and a large kitchen, lounge and dining room with a larder. The 12,648 sq ft plot includes a fenced garden with a gated entrance and a shed for storage, plus a fireplace and a cellar. The house has new heat pump heating. Amenities are close by in Adriers, with Bussière-Poitevine, Bellac and Lussac nearby. Asking €122,000, about €1,061/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom townhouse with terrace, garage and cellar in Nueil-les-Aubiers, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 3 dormitorios con terraza, garaje y sótano en Nueil-les-Aubiers, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: Two-storey townhouse of 145 m2, built in 1947 in stone and brick, on a 197 m2 plot. It has 6 rooms, including 3 bedrooms, a bright 27.54 m2 living room, a fitted open-plan kitchen, a bathroom and a toilet. Features include a terrace, garage, external parking, cellar and land. Heating comes from a wood stove and a heat pump with radiators, and hot water from a thermodynamic system. Schools and shops such as bakeries and a supermarket are nearby. Asking €123,050, about €849/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom stone village house with cellar in Beaumontois-en-Périgord, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra totalmente renovada de 3 dormitorios con sótano en Beaumontois-en-Périgord, Dordogne
homes.summary: This fully renovated stone house in the heart of the village is ready to move into. The ground floor has a large living room with an open-plan kitchen, and the first floor has a landing or study, a master bedroom with dressing room, and a shower room with WC. The second floor has a laundry room, two further bedrooms and a bathroom with WC, and a cellar offers space for storage. Gas central heating, double glazing and mains drainage are included. Asking €124,800, about €1,076/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Les Gours, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Les Gours, Charente
homes.summary: Renovated house with 3 bedrooms and 126 m2 of living space at the end of a cul-de-sac. Ground floor: kitchen area with wood-burning stove, 33 m2 double living room, renovated shower room and separate WC. First floor: 3 bedrooms, an annex bedroom and a shower room with WC. Enclosed tree-filled garden with garage, two outbuildings and 5,274 sq ft of land. Heating by wood and fuel, double glazing and insulation, with Aigre 10 minutes away and a lake less than 2 km away. Asking €127,000, about €1,008/m².

homes.title: Townhouse with garden, terrace and double garage in Villaines-la-Juhel, Mayenne
homes.title_es: Casa adosada con jardín, terraza y garaje doble en Villaines-la-Juhel, Mayenne
homes.summary: This townhouse in Villaines-la-Juhel spreads over three levels across 146 m² of living area. It has 6 rooms, 4 bedrooms, a mezzanine, a laundry room and a wood stove in the living area. Outdoor features include a garden of about 319 m², a terrace facing south and west, and a 582 m² plot. There is also a 15.50 m² cellar, a 29 m² double garage and outbuildings. Heating is by town gas, and the house is connected to mains drainage. Asking €127,000, about €870/m².

homes.title: Farmhouse with mezzanine, garden and large plot in Saint-Denis-sur-Ouanne, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con entreplanta, jardín y gran parcela en Saint-Denis-sur-Ouanne, Borgoña
homes.summary: This farmhouse-style house offers 172 m2 of living space with two bedrooms in Saint-Denis-sur-Ouanne, Burgundy. The ground floor has a living room with a wood-burning stove, a dining area, a fitted kitchen, a hallway, a bedroom, a shower room, a WC and a boiler room. A spacious mezzanine overlooks the living area and can be adapted as a study, games room or extra sleeping area, and a hatch gives access to an attic. The plot of about 1,800 m2 includes a garden, a storage shed and an outbuilding, in a peaceful setting. Heating is by wood, and the house suits use as a holiday home or a year-round residence. Asking €128,000, about €744/m².

homes.title: Character 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Gannay-sur-Loire, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Gannay-sur-Loire, Allier
homes.summary: This character house in Gannay-sur-Loire offers 175 m2 of living space and three bedrooms. The first floor has an entrance hall, two living rooms, a kitchen/dining room, two bedrooms and a bathroom, and two more bedrooms are upstairs. The 2430 m2 plot includes a garden, plus a vast garage with workshop, a boiler room and a cellar. It is a stone's throw from the Canal du Nivernais, with Decize about 15 minutes away and Moulins less than 30 minutes. Asking €129,000, about €737/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom cottage with barn and garden in Darnac, Limousin
homes.title_es: Casa de campo renovada de 4 dormitorios con granero y jardín en Darnac, Limousin
homes.summary: This renovated cottage in Darnac has four bedrooms and two bathrooms, with a living room featuring a log burning fire, exposed beams and stone walls. The L-shaped kitchen has fitted units and appliances, and the dining area has a wood burning cooker. The property has a fenced garden with views, a large barn across the lane, and 15,296 sq ft of land. It has radiators and wood heating, and is 4 minutes' drive from a village and 20 minutes from two larger towns with train stations. Asking €136,250, about €1,126/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom house with mountain views, garage and terrace in Espezel, Aude
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios con vistas a la montaña, garaje y terraza en Espezel, Aude
homes.summary: This 168 m² house sits on the Sault plateau in the village of Espezel. It has 4 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, spread over three floors, with a shower room and a fitted kitchen. Outdoor and extra features include a 25 m² south-facing terrace, a 25 m² garage, a balcony on the second floor and mountain views. The house has wood and electric heating and is connected to the mains sewer system. Ski resorts are a short distance away. Asking €138,000, about €821/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, fireplace and open views in Ribérac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, chimenea y vistas abiertas en Ribérac, Dordoña
homes.summary: This house in Ribérac, Dordogne, has open views and a basement level. The ground floor includes an entrance, a living room with a fireplace, a kitchen open to the living room, an office, a bathroom with shower and a separate WC. The home has 125 m2 of living area and bedrooms on both levels, plus a summer kitchen and cellar in the basement. The 860 m2 plot includes a garden, a shed, a garage and one parking space, and the home has central heating. Asking €139,500, about €1,116/m².

homes.title: Well maintained townhouse with walled garden and workshop in Richelieu, Indre-et-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa adosada bien mantenida con jardín amurallado y taller en Richelieu, Indre-et-Loire
homes.summary: This well maintained townhouse offers 143 m2 of living space a stone's throw from Richelieu town centre. Inside are an entrance hall, a living room with an open fireplace, a dining room, a fitted kitchen, a laundry/heating room, a WC and a storeroom. Upstairs, a landing serves four bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate WC. Outside, there is a small walled garden, a large workshop with an attic above, a covered double garage and a secure parking area. Collective central heating and double glazed joinery complete the home. Asking €145,000, about €1,014/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 6-bedroom stone house with terrace and garden in Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra lista para entrar a vivir, con terraza y jardín en Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente
homes.summary: This move-in ready detached stone house sits at the end of a cul-de-sac in a peaceful hamlet. It offers six bedrooms and 143 m2 of living space, including a living room and dining room. A garden in a tree-filled park, a terrace with no overlooking neighbours, and 22,895 sq ft of land surround the home. A former pigsty outbuilding, a fireplace and two wood stoves complete the property. Roof, wastewater treatment, wiring and wall insulation were upgraded in the past ten years. Asking €149,900, about €1,048/m².

homes.title: Four-bedroom house with pool and garden in Ruffec, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de cuatro dormitorios con piscina y jardín en Ruffec, Charente
homes.summary: This 1970s pavilion house has four bedrooms, and the basement bedroom has its own dressing room, bathroom and furnished living area. The 34 m² living room has parquet flooring, three patio doors and a fireplace, and the home also has a shower room and a separate kitchen. Outside there is a garden, a terrace, an 8 m x 4 m pool, views, 70,062 sq ft of land and a garage. It has oil-fired central heating and double-glazed windows. The hamlet is 10 km from Ruffec and 6 km from Verteuil-sur-Charente. Asking €149,950, about €987/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom house with garden and garage in Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa totalmente reformada de 4 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente
homes.summary: This fully renovated house was completed in 2024 with a new roof. The ground floor has a 34 sqm living and dining room, a fitted kitchen, an office, a utility room and a 30 sqm veranda, and upstairs are four bedrooms and a bathroom. Outside there is a garden, a 19 sqm garage with an electric door, a 13 sqm garden shed and an 11 sqm outbuilding on 17,244 sq ft of land. Gas boiler heating and a new wood-burning stove in the living room. Asking €159,000, about €1,082/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 4-bedroom house with basement and garage in Junay, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa totalmente reformada de 4 dormitorios con sótano y garaje en Junay, Borgoña
homes.summary: This fully renovated house is ready to move into now. It has four bedrooms, two on the main level and two upstairs, plus a fitted kitchen and a large reception room of nearly 60 m² with a wood stove insert. Extras include a balcony, a full basement with garage area and cellar, and a separate garage with inspection pit and workshop. Land covers 11,388 sq ft. Heating is central oil-fired with a condensing boiler, plus reversible heat-pump air conditioning and double glazing. Asking €159,000, about €970/m².

homes.title: Detached 4-bedroom farmhouse with garden and land in Plumieux, Côtes-d'Armor
homes.title_es: Casa de campo independiente de 4 dormitorios con jardín y terreno en Plumieux, Côtes-d'Armor
homes.summary: This detached farmhouse sits halfway between Josselin and Loudéac, in Plumieux. It offers 4 bedrooms, 2 on the ground floor, 3 bathrooms, a large farmhouse style kitchen, a dining room and a lounge with a wood burner. Outside there is a landscaped garden with fruit trees and a well, an old wood-clad shed, a large convertible attic, and about 8,255 m2 of land with south exposure. Heating is by wood, and Cambout is about 2 km away. Asking €160,000, about €842/m².

homes.title: Character 4-bedroom house with terrace and countryside views in Champallement, Nièvre
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter de 4 dormitorios con terraza y vistas en Champallement, Nièvre
homes.summary: Character house with 204 m2 of living space, 4 bedrooms and 5 rooms, heated by gas-fired central heating. The living room has an open fireplace and ceiling beams, and opens onto a 30 m2 kitchen/dining room overlooking the church. A terrace of about 27 m2 offers panoramic views of the countryside and forest, and the plot includes a garden. It sits beside the church in Champallement, between Corbigny and Brinon-sur-Beuvron, less than 3 hours from Paris. Asking €165,000, about €809/m².

homes.title: Stone house with 4 bedrooms, enclosed garden and terrace in Chizé, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con 4 dormitorios, jardín cerrado y terraza en Chizé, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: Stone house of 172 m² with 4 bedrooms over two floors, a bathroom and a water room. The ground floor has a 42 m² living-dining room with a wood stove and an 18 m² fitted kitchen. The fully enclosed west-facing garden has 3 levels, and an east-facing courtyard has a terrace. Wood heating can be easily extended with a heat pump, and the house is connected to mains sewer. Asking €168,800, about €981/m².

homes.title: 50 m² flat with city views on the tram line in Le Mans
homes.title_es: Piso de 50 m² con vistas a la ciudad junto al tranvía en Le Mans
homes.summary: 50.7 m² on the 5th floor in Maillets-Bellevue: a living room, a modern kitchen, a bedroom and a new shower room, with long views over the rooftops. The T2 tram stops at the door and the station is three minutes by car. Asking €55,000, about €1,086/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 2-bedroom townhouse with open-plan kitchen in Châlus, Haute-Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa adosada totalmente reformada de 2 dormitorios con cocina abierta en Châlus, Haute-Vienne
homes.summary: This fully renovated townhouse offers 65 m2 of living space over several floors. The ground floor has a living room with open-plan kitchen and a separate WC, while the first floor holds a bedroom and shower room. The second floor has a second bedroom with bathtub, washbasin and separate WC, and the third floor has an attic that could be converted. Double glazing, electric heating and mains drainage complete the home. Asking €70,850, about €1,090/m².

homes.title: Stone village house with land and countryside walks in Limoux, Aude
homes.title_es: Casa rústica de piedra en pueblo con terreno y paseos por el campo en Limoux, Aude
homes.summary: Rustic stone village house in a quiet hamlet near Limoux, Aude. The ground floor has a kitchen/dining room, a large lounge at the rear and a shower room with WC, while upstairs there are two bedrooms and a second shower room with toilet. The house has 592 sq ft of land and a full sized attic that could be developed into a roof terrace, subject to the necessary permissions. Countryside walks start from the doorstep, and the house has electric heating. The town of Limoux is 15 minutes away. Asking €84,500, about €994/m².

homes.title: Stone house with terrace, garden and barn in Colondannes, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con terraza, jardín y granero en Colondannes, Creuse
homes.summary: Stone house on the edge of Colondannes village, with 3 bedrooms and an 82 sq m living area. The layout includes a separate kitchen, a living/dining room with a fireplace, a shower room and a separate WC. Outdoors there is a terrace, a 450 sq m garden, a 2,500 sq m plot nearby and a detached 82 sq m barn. A garage area for one car is in the basement. Heating is oil-fired central with cast iron radiators. La Souterraine is 15 minutes away and Dun-le-Palestel is 5 minutes away. Asking €89,500, about €1,091/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready terraced house with garden and terrace in Boubers-sur-Canche, Pas-de-Calais
homes.title_es: Casa adosada lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y terraza en Boubers-sur-Canche, Pas-de-Calais
homes.summary: This move-in ready terraced house is in good general condition and ready to move into. It has two bedrooms, an office, a 21 sq m living room, an 18 sq m dining room and an 11 sq m fitted kitchen. Outdoor features include a garden, a wooden terrace, a cellar and 2,142 sq ft of land. Oil-fired central heating, double glazing with shutters and mains drainage complete the property. The living room has a chimney flue. Asking €94,000, about €1,093/m².

homes.title: Stone house in good condition with terrace and garage in Saint-Fraimbault, Orne, Normandy
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra en buen estado con terraza y garaje en Saint-Fraimbault, Orne, Normandía
homes.summary: This stone house with a slate roof is in good condition and has 91 m2 of living space. It has a separate kitchen, a ground floor shower room and two very large double bedrooms with parquet floors on the first floor. Outdoor features include a south facing terrace, 4,650 sq ft of land, an outbuilding with an attic, 2 garages and 5 parking spaces. The lounge has a fireplace with a wood burning stove, and the home has electric heating. Passais is 2.5 miles away and Ambrières les Vallées is a 10 minute drive. Asking €95,850, about €1,053/m².

homes.title: Village house with four bedrooms and games room in Olonzac, Hérault
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo con cuatro dormitorios y sala de juegos en Olonzac, Hérault
homes.summary: This village house in Olonzac offers about 95 square metres of living space. It has four bedrooms, a kitchen, a living and dining room, an office, a games room and two shower rooms. The agent describes a layout suited to a family, a second-home project or tourist accommodation. Electric heating is listed among its features. Nearby are the Canal du Midi, Lake Jouarres, the Minervois vineyards and the historic village of Minerve, with Carcassonne and Narbonne also close by. Asking €97,500, about €1,026/m².

homes.title: Riverside 2-bedroom house with terrace and garage in Axat, Aude
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios junto al río con terraza y garaje en Axat, Aude
homes.summary: This single-storey house is in very good condition, with 62 m2 of living space. It has two bedrooms, a fitted kitchen, a living and dining room with numerous windows, and a shower room with WC. Double glazing and electric radiators provide comfort, and a 100 sq m courtyard leads to an 18.69 sq m garage. The house sits in the heart of Axat on the banks of the Aude River, with river views and shops and public transport nearby. Asking €98,000, about €1,581/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and outbuildings in La Trimouille, Poitou-Charentes
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y dependencias en La Trimouille, Poitou-Charentes
homes.summary: Renovated single-level house with a new fitted kitchen, ready to move into straight away. It has 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and a light living room with patio doors onto a balcony. Outdoor and extra space includes a fenced garden, outbuildings, a garage, a cellar and 15,737 sq ft of land. Electric radiators provide heating, and the living room has a fireplace surround for a wood or pellet burner. La Trimouille offers cafes, shops, a pharmacy and a cinema nearby. Asking €100,000, about €1,333/m².

homes.title: Restored 2-bedroom house with barn and garden in Chef-Boutonne, Deux-Sèvres, Poitou-Charentes
homes.title_es: Casa restaurada de 2 dormitorios con granero y jardín en Chef-Boutonne, Deux-Sèvres, Poitou-Charentes
homes.summary: Restored house with a welcoming cottage feel, set over two floors. Two bright reception rooms, a galley kitchen, a downstairs WC, a bathroom and two bedrooms. A spacious barn with a former cattle shed, a garden with established trees and plants, and a garden storage outbuilding, plus 13,670 sq ft of land. A concealed storage area connects the house to the barn. Electric heating. Asking €101,750, about €1,131/m².

homes.title: Well maintained townhouse with garden and garage in Arnac-la-Poste, Haute-Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo bien mantenida con jardín y garaje en Arnac-la-Poste, Haute-Vienne
homes.summary: This well maintained townhouse in central Arnac-la-Poste offers 98 m2 of living space. Rooms include a living room, fitted kitchen, bright lounge, two bedrooms, a shower room with WC and a utility area. Outdoors there is a rear garden, a garage and 4,715 sq ft of land. Electric radiators provide heating. The A20 motorway is quick to reach, and La Souterraine is a few minutes away by car. Asking €104,500, about €1,066/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom house with garden and cellar in Verteuil-sur-Charente, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y sótano en Verteuil-sur-Charente, Charente
homes.summary: This move-in ready house has two bedrooms, a living room with a fireplace and wood-burning stove, a fitted kitchen and a shower room with WC. The property has a private garden across a small lane with an off-street parking space, a small outbuilding and a cellar. The plot covers 4,521 sq ft of land. The home was recently rewired and redecorated, is connected to mains drainage and has wood heating. The house is a five-minute stroll from the village centre, and Ruffec is a five-minute drive away. Asking €105,000, about €1,207/m².

homes.title: Well maintained 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in L'Absie, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios bien mantenida con jardín y garaje en L'Absie, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: Well maintained three-bedroom house with two bathrooms, offered as a secondary home. Ground floor has a 33 m2 living room with wood-burning stove, fitted kitchen, utility room and shower room with WC. First floor has three bedrooms with parquet flooring, a bathroom with shower and bath, and an attic. Outside there is a low maintenance garden, an attached 19 m2 garage and 3,767 sq ft of land. Oil-fired central heating and double glazing, with shops in the village and Bressuire or Parthenay 30 minutes away. Asking €114,400, about €1,122/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bedroom village house with terrace in Labruguière, Tarn, Midi-Pyrénées
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo lista para entrar a vivir con terraza en Labruguière, Tarn, Midi-Pyrénées
homes.summary: Move-in ready village house in a hamlet of Labruguière, with no work required. The ground floor has a lounge, dining room and open-plan kitchen, plus a utility room with a toilet. Upstairs are two bedrooms of 15 to 18 m², a 7 m² study and a shower room. Outside there is a 25 m² terrace and a 4.5 m² cellar for storage. The home has an air-to-water heat pump, double glazing and fibre-optic internet. Asking €115,000, about €1,186/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with terraces and views in Le Bousquet-d'Orb, Hérault, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 2 dormitorios con terrazas y vistas en Le Bousquet-d'Orb, Hérault, Languedoc
homes.summary: This renovated house spans three levels in Saint-Martin, above Le Bousquet-d'Orb. It has two bedrooms, one bathroom, a separate WC and a fitted separate kitchen. Outdoor space includes several terraces, one facing south, plus a balcony. Three cellars on the ground floor offer storage or conversion possibilities, and the views over the surrounding area are exceptional. Heating is electric, and the village is five minutes from local amenities. Asking €119,000, about €1,133/m².

homes.title: Town centre house with garden and garage in Le Croisty, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa en el centro con jardín y garaje en Le Croisty, Bretaña
homes.summary: This house is located in the town centre of Le Croisty, in the Morbihan department of Brittany. The home, a former shop, offers an entrance, a separate fitted and equipped kitchen, a dining room, two bedrooms and a large bedroom upstairs. It includes a garden, a garage and 215 sq ft of land. The basement was formerly a butcher's laboratory. Asking €123,000, about €911/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom village house with fireplace and land in Cressy-sur-Somme, Saône-et-Loire, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 4 dormitorios con chimenea y terreno en Cressy-sur-Somme, Saône-et-Loire, Borgoña
homes.summary: This village house in Cressy-sur-Somme offers 150 m² of living space. Downstairs there is a living room with a fireplace, a kitchen, a bathroom, a toilet and a utility and boiler room, while upstairs has four bedrooms and a dressing room. There is an attic, a cellar, a small outbuilding and a woodshed, plus a plot of 883 m². Heating comes from a wood-burning insert and a wood-fired boiler, and the property is connected to mains drainage. Asking €123,000, about €820/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom house with terrace and wooded land in Chassenon, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios con terraza y terreno arbolado en Chassenon, Charente
homes.summary: This four-bedroom house in Chassenon, Charente offers 124 m2 of living space across six rooms. It has a 29 m2 living room with a wood-burning insert, an 11 m2 kitchen and a bathroom with a bathtub and shower. Outside there is a covered terrace, a wooded plot of 3,681 sq ft, and two garages with four parking spaces. A full basement can be used as a cellar, storage space or workshop. Heating comes from a fuel boiler with hot-water radiators in every room. Asking €126,500, about €1,020/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom stone house in good condition with garden and views in Aigre, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios en buen estado con jardín y vistas en Aigre, Charente
homes.summary: This 19th-century stone house is in good condition and has three bedrooms and two bathrooms. It includes an equipped separate kitchen and a garage with parking for three vehicles. The property has an enclosed garden and a lovely view of the fields and woods, plus 6,114 sq ft of land. It is heated by oil-fired central heating and has double glazing and excellent energy performance. A pharmacy, a grocery and bakery, and the Post Office are three kilometres away. Asking €127,000, about €1,008/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom stone house with courtyard garden and wood stove in Yvignac-la-Tour, Côtes-d'Armor
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 4 dormitorios con jardín y estufa de leña en Yvignac-la-Tour, Côtes-d'Armor
homes.summary: This stone-built house stands in the centre of Yvignac-la-Tour, within easy walking distance of the village amenities. It spans three floors with six rooms, four bedrooms, a living room, a fitted kitchen, a shower room with WC and a storage room. Outside, a courtyard garden and 1,044 sq ft of land complete the property. The living room has a feature fireplace with a wood burning stove, and the home uses wood heating. Broons is 5 minutes away and Dinan is about 20 minutes away. Asking €128,400, about €1,035/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Coussey, Vosges, Lorraine
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y garaje en Coussey, Vosges, Lorena
homes.summary: This move-in ready village house offers 136 m2 of living space across 4 rooms. It has 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a large living room spanning both sides of the building, and a separate equipped kitchen with storage and a dining area. Outdoor features include a garden, a garage with one parking space, and 4,123 sq ft of land. The home has oil-fired central heating, double glazing throughout, new PVC windows and electric shutters. Asking €129,000, about €949/m².

homes.title: Stone house with terrace, garage and land in Porte-du-Quercy, Lot
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con terraza, garaje y terreno en Porte-du-Quercy, Lot
homes.summary: This traditional stone house in the village of Porte-du-Quercy, Lot, has an entrance hall, a dining room with kitchen and a utility kitchen with an old bread oven. Upstairs there are four large bedrooms and a bathroom. There is a 17 m² covered terrace, a large garage, outdoor parking and a 340 m² plot of land a few dozen metres from the house. Oil-fired central heating is fitted, and the energy rating is E. Asking €129,900, about €849/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom townhouse with garden, fireplace and land in Nogent-le-Roi, Eure-et-Loir
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 4 dormitorios con jardín, chimenea y terreno en Nogent-le-Roi, Eure-et-Loir
homes.summary: This traditional townhouse in Nogent-le-Roi is arranged over two floors. The ground floor has an entrance, a study, a living room opening onto a dining room, a separate kitchen and two bedrooms, while upstairs there are two more bedrooms. The house also has one shower room, a fireplace and gas-fired central heating. The enclosed 466 m² plot includes a garden, a workshop and an outbuilding. The attic can be converted into a playroom, workshop or storage space. Asking €133,000, about €1,064/m².

homes.title: 5-bedroom townhouse with garden, terrace and fireplace in Thouars, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 5 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y chimenea en Thouars, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: This townhouse in Thouars offers about 143 square metres of living space across three levels. It has six rooms, five bedrooms, one bathroom, a fitted kitchen and a laundry room. Outside there is a terrace of about 50 m², a garden and a 184 m² plot, plus a vaulted cellar and a fireplace in the living room. Gas-fired central heating and hot water, double glazing, electric shutters and fibre optic. Energy rating C, near Parc Imbert and Ferdinand Buisson primary school. Asking €137,000, about €958/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom townhouse with garden in Villeneuve-sur-Lot, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Adosado totalmente reformado de 3 dormitorios con jardín en Villeneuve-sur-Lot, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This fully renovated townhouse offers three bedrooms, an office, two shower rooms and a separate WC. The ground floor has a kitchen of about 20 m², a living room and a veranda opening directly outside, plus a utility room with cellar access. Outside there is a garden and 2,831 sq ft of land. Electrical and plumbing have been redone, the roof is in very good condition, and a city gas boiler provides heating. The house is connected to the mains sewer and has 139 m² of living area. Asking €139,900, about €1,006/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom village house with garden and land in Aspet, Haute-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 4 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y terreno en Aspet, Haute-Garonne
homes.summary: This move-in ready village house offers 132 m2 of living space over three levels. It has 6 rooms, including 4 bedrooms, a living room with a wood-burning stove and 2 shower rooms. Across from the house is a small garden enclosed by stone walls, with a large garden shed and 1,023 sq ft of land. The roof is insulated, the windows are double-glazed PVC, the electrical system was updated in 2008 and the oil-fired boiler is recent. Heating is by oil-fired central heating. Asking €140,000, about €1,061/m².

homes.title: Semi-detached 3-bedroom house with garden, orchard and barn in Cercoux, Charente-Maritime
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 3 dormitorios con jardín, huerto y granero en Cercoux, Charente-Maritime
homes.summary: Semi-detached house on the edge of the village of Cercoux, suitable as a main or secondary residence. It has three double bedrooms, a living room and a dining room with wood-burning stoves, a kitchen and a family bathroom. Outdoors there is a partly fenced garden, a 3,400 m2 plot with an orchard, a 20 m2 south-facing veranda and a 60 m2 detached barn. Within walking distance of the village are a restaurant, bakery, supermarket, medical centre, school and garage. Asking €148,000, about €1,028/m².

homes.title: Well maintained 4-bedroom townhouse with garden and terrace in Richelieu, Indre-et-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 4 dormitorios bien mantenida con jardín y terraza en Richelieu, Indre-et-Loire
homes.summary: This well maintained townhouse offers 131 m2 of living space on two levels. The ground floor has a living room with fireplace, a large kitchen opening onto a terrace, a large bedroom and a small living area. The upper floor has three bedrooms, a study area and a bathroom. Outdoors there is a walled private garden with a covered passage to the street, and a double garage with courtyard is available to purchase. It has electric heating and sits close to the Market Square in Richelieu. Asking €148,400, about €1,133/m².

homes.title: Bright 3-bedroom house with fireplaces and garden in Faye-la-Vineuse, Indre-et-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa luminosa de 3 dormitorios con chimeneas y jardín en Faye-la-Vineuse, Indre-et-Loire
homes.summary: The house offers approximately 129 m² with three bedrooms, a very bright living and dining room with fireplaces, and a kitchen. It also has a small dining room opening onto a sunny courtyard, a cosy living room, a bathroom, a shower room, two separate WCs and a pantry. Outdoors there is a leafy garden with a small outbuilding. Heating is collective central heating. The house sits in a listed medieval village, 9 minutes from Richelieu. Asking €148,400, about €1,150/m².

homes.title: House with garage and open-plan kitchen in Caudiès-de-Fenouillèdes, Pyrénées-Orientales
homes.title_es: Casa con garaje y cocina abierta en Caudiès-de-Fenouillèdes, Pyrénées-Orientales
homes.summary: This 204 m2 house has 8 rooms and 3 bedrooms. Two shower rooms and separate toilets are included, along with an open-plan equipped kitchen. A garage with one parking space is included. Electric heating is installed, and the energy performance class is B while the climate class is A. Estimated annual energy costs for standard use were between 1570 and 2180 euros for 2021 to 2023, including subscriptions. Asking €149,900, about €735/m².

homes.title: Detached 5-bedroom house with garden, barn and land in Ruffec, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 5 dormitorios con jardín, granero y terreno en Ruffec, Charente
homes.summary: This detached house has 8 rooms, including 5 bedrooms, a separate equipped kitchen and a shower room. Outside there are two private enclosed gardens, a barn of about 95 m², a workshop, a garage and other outbuildings, on 37,889 sq ft of land. There is parking for three cars, with one space in the garage, and oil-fired central heating. The house is 3 km from Ruffec, with schools, a train station and main roads to Poitiers and Angoulême. Asking €149,950, about €872/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom village house with terrace and views in Bélarga, Hérault
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo reformada de 4 dormitorios con terraza y vistas en Bélarga, Hérault
homes.summary: This renovated village house has been updated to keep its classic character with modern comfort. It has four bedrooms, two shower rooms, a guest WC and a fully fitted kitchen. Features include a fireplace, a large terrace with water and electricity, views over the rooftops and the Hérault river running through the village. Double glazing throughout and a roof replaced in 2014. Montpellier is within easy reach, and the coast is about 20 minutes away. Asking €150,000, about €1,250/m².

homes.title: Detached 5-bedroom house with fireplace and plot in Saint-Julien-Chapteuil, Haute-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 5 dormitorios con chimenea y parcela en Saint-Julien-Chapteuil, Haute-Loire
homes.summary: This detached house of 220 m² spreads over three floors with five bedrooms. The ground floor has a large living area, a separate living and dining room, a kitchen, a shower room and a separate toilet. Upstairs are a living area, three bedrooms, a study and a bathroom, plus two attic bedrooms and a mezzanine. A fireplace with a wood-burning stove, individual heating and radiators, plus a plot amid green spaces. Schools, shops and transport are nearby, with Le Puy-en-Velay 17 minutes away and Estables ski resort 29 minutes. Asking €150,000, about €682/m².

homes.title: Stone house with canal views, garden and fireplace in Rohan, Morbihan, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con vistas al canal, jardín y chimenea en Rohan, Morbihan, Bretaña
homes.summary: Stone house overlooking the canal and the Nantes to Brest cycle path, with 130 m2 of living space and four bedrooms. The ground floor has a living room, dining room and fully equipped kitchen opening onto the garden, plus a shower room. The first floor holds three bright bedrooms, two shower rooms and an office. Heat pump, pellet stove and double glazing are fitted, and the landscaped garden on a 1,397 m2 plot includes a parking space. Shops, services and schools are within walking distance. Asking €156,600, about €1,205/m².

homes.title: Spacious 4-bedroom townhouse with terrace and cellar in Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Amplio adosado de 4 dormitorios con terraza y sótano en Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.summary: Spacious 160 m2 townhouse in the centre of Bergerac, with all shops within walking distance. The ground floor has an entrance hall, cellar and utility room, while the first floor holds a fitted kitchen, living room, 2 bedrooms, bathroom, shower room and WC. The top floor adds 2 bedrooms, storage rooms, a hallway, a shower room and a WC. The kitchen opens onto a terrace, and the property includes 1,733 sq ft of land. It has a new mains gas boiler, double glazing, electric shutters and mains drainage. Asking €161,000, about €1,006/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom house with garden and garage in Montluçon, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 4 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Montluçon, Allier
homes.summary: Fully renovated in 2023, this house offers 130 m2 of living space and a fitted, equipped kitchen opening onto a living room. It has 3 bedrooms, a mezzanine, 2 bathrooms and a toilet. The full basement includes a garage, workshop, cellar, laundry room and one additional bedroom. The enclosed plot has a garden and 3,229 sq ft of land, and the house is heated by gas-fired central heating. It is close to all amenities in Montluçon. Asking €171,000, about €1,315/m².

homes.title: Furnished studio with a balcony near the Palais des Congrès, Perpignan
homes.title_es: Estudio amueblado con balcón junto al Palacio de Congresos, Perpiñán
homes.summary: 35 m² on the 4th floor with a lift in a secure residence with a garden: a bright living room with a balcony, a semi-open fitted kitchen, a shower room and a cellar. Sold furnished; charges about €115 a month including heating and water. Asking €57,000, about €1,631/m².

homes.title: Recently renovated through flat with a heat pump in Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Piso pasante recién reformado con bomba de calor en Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: 52 m² in a handsome building on boulevard Valbenoite, near the university: a big living room over the courtyard, a fitted kitchen, a bedroom, a shower room and a WC. Recently renovated, heat-pump heating and double glazing; a garage can be added. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €60,000, about €1,154/m².

homes.title: Town house with a mezzanine in historic Saint-Mathieu, Perpignan
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo con altillo en el barrio histórico de Saint-Mathieu, Perpiñán
homes.summary: A 50 m² town house at the edge of the historic Saint-Mathieu quarter, with a light well: a living room with an open kitchen, a master bedroom with its own bathroom and WC, and a mezzanine upstairs. Freshly finished, ready to live in. Asking €60,000, about €1,200/m².

homes.title: Renovated townhouse with new kitchen and air conditioning in Masseube, Gers
homes.title_es: Casa adosada renovada con cocina nueva y aire acondicionado en Masseube, Gers
homes.summary: A renovated 70 m² townhouse in Masseube for €69,500, under €1,000 per m², close to the shops and services. Downstairs a 25 m² living room opens to a fully fitted kitchen, with a storage room and WC. Upstairs are two bedrooms of 13 and 16 m², each with its own shower and basin. The roof was redone in 2013, the attic is insulated and there is reversible air conditioning. Connected to mains drainage. Energy rating C, good for an older house. The photos show fresh floors, a new kitchen and clean shower units. No garden is mentioned.

homes.title: Cottage with garden and valley views in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con jardín y vistas al valle en Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.summary: This cottage sits in a peaceful village in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente. The ground floor has a living room, kitchen, pantry, shower room and separate WC. Upstairs, a large loft serves as a bedroom and has space to create two bedrooms. The property has over 800 m² of garden, with views across the valley, on 9,537 sq ft of land. It has electric heating, and the historic village of Nanteuil-en-Vallée is under a 10-minute drive away. Asking €71,500, about €1,067/m².

homes.title: Three-level village house with attic bedroom in Espéraza, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de tres niveles con dormitorio en el ático en Espéraza, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This village house in Espéraza is arranged over three levels in a quiet setting. The ground floor has a living room with a fitted open-plan kitchen and a shower room with WC. The first floor has a south-facing bedroom, a north-facing bedroom with a mezzanine, and a shower room with WC. The top floor has an attic bedroom, and the house suits an investor or a second home. Asking €75,000, about €1,000/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 1-bedroom house with barn and land in Saint-Sébastien, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa de 1 dormitorio lista para entrar a vivir con granero y terreno en Saint-Sébastien, Creuse
homes.summary: This move-in ready detached house has a through living room, fitted kitchen, dining room or study opening onto a partly covered terrace, one double bedroom, bathroom with walk-in shower and utility room. A spacious loft upstairs could provide more bedrooms. Outside there is almost 7,000 m2 of land, an attached barn, a cellar and a single garage. Heating is by oil boiler with radiators in every room. Shops and a supermarket in Eguzon are 8 km away, and the A20 is 5 minutes away. Asking €85,000, about €1,232/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom village house with garden and barn in Combiers, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 2 dormitorios con jardín y granero en Combiers, Charente
homes.summary: This house in the village of Combiers has a sitting room opening onto the rear garden, an eat-in kitchen, a large double bedroom and a smaller single bedroom, plus a large shower room with WC and an attic. An attached barn offers parking or workshop space and the potential to enlarge the existing accommodation, subject to necessary permissions. The plot covers 4,090 sq ft of land and the home is heated by wood. It is close to the Charente and Dordogne border. Asking €88,000, about €1,114/m².

homes.title: Stone 3-bedroom townhouse with shared garden in Saint-Séverin, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de piedra de 3 dormitorios con jardín compartido en Saint-Séverin, Charente
homes.summary: Stone townhouse with character in Saint-Séverin, Charente, France. The ground floor has an entrance hall or office, a kitchen with outside access and a living room, and the staircase leads to three bedrooms, a family bathroom, a toilet and the attic. Outside there is a shared garden of 200 m2 and a plot of 2,153 sq ft of land. Parking is in the free public car park, and the town has bars, restaurants, a supermarket and a post office. Heating is electric and the energy performance rating is F. Asking €89,250, about €1,130/m².

homes.title: Well-insulated 2-bedroom house with terrace and land in Caunes-Minervois, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa bien aislada de 2 dormitorios con terraza y terreno en Caunes-Minervois, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This well-insulated house offers 84 m2 of living space with two bedrooms and one bathroom. The ground floor has a storage room and a WC with a washing machine, and the first-floor open-plan lounge, dining and kitchen area is reached by a wooden staircase. The top floor holds both bedrooms, each with a wash basin and a shower room with a separate WC. Outdoor features include a small terrace for al fresco dining and 108 sq ft of land. The home has reversible heating and cooling. Asking €98,000, about €1,167/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house with garden, land and mezzanine office in Confolens, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios con jardín, terreno y entreplanta de oficina en Confolens, Charente
homes.summary: This is a 2-bedroom house in a small quiet hamlet a few minutes' drive from Confolens. Inside there is a spacious lounge, a cozy dining room, an equipped kitchen, a fireplace, a mezzanine office, a shower room and a separate WC. Outside there is a private garden and small outbuildings, and the 2.93 acres of land are held in separate plots. It suits a second home or a permanent residence. Asking €99,000, about €1,165/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with terrace, cellar and garage in Le Donjon, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con terraza, sótano y garaje en Le Donjon, Allier
homes.summary: This house in the centre of a small village offers 90 square metres of living space. The raised ground floor has a fitted kitchen, a living room with terrace access, three bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate toilet. The basement holds a cellar, a workshop, a summer kitchen and a garage, plus additional detached garages, a courtyard and land. It is heated by a heat pump and lies 40 minutes from Roanne and 2 hours from Lyon. Asking €105,000, about €1,167/m².

homes.title: House with garden, terrace and walled plot in Devay, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa con jardín, terraza y parcela vallada en Devay, Borgoña
homes.summary: This house is raised on a basement in a calm, pleasant setting in Devay. The ground floor has an entrance, a fitted kitchen, a dining room, three bedrooms and a bathroom with toilet. The basement adds a kitchen and laundry room, a study, a bedroom and a garage. Outside, there is a 70 m2 terrace with no overlooking and a walled, tree-covered plot of over 1800 m2 with a garden. Comfort comes from individual oil heating installed in 2013, air conditioning and double-glazed windows. Asking €105,000, about €1,000/m².

homes.title: Detached 4-bedroom house with garage, garden and land in Ménéac, Morbihan
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 4 dormitorios con garaje, jardín y terreno en Ménéac, Morbihan
homes.summary: This detached house, built of concrete block with a slate roof, sits on the outskirts of the village of Ménéac. It has 101 m2 of living space across six rooms, including four bedrooms, an entrance hall, a utility room, a kitchen open to the dining and living room, a shower room and a toilet. A garage and a garden come with the home, and the 2,480 m2 plot includes a garden shed. Heating is provided by electric heating and aerothermal heating. Asking €105,520, about €1,045/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom house with enclosed garden and terrace in Montluçon, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios con jardín cerrado y terraza en Montluçon, Allier
homes.summary: This house in Montluçon, Allier, was built in the 1930s and sits in a quiet location close to shops. It has a double living room that opens onto a terrace, a fitted kitchen and 4 bedrooms, with 105 m2 of living space. The enclosed garden, cellar, basement with boiler room and garage complete the home. The plot covers 6,308 sq ft of land. The energy rating is F, with estimated annual energy costs between €1,986 and €2,456. Asking €107,000, about €1,019/m².

homes.title: Move-in-ready 2-bedroom country house with garden and outbuilding in Nouzerines, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa de campo lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y dependencia en Nouzerines, Creuse
homes.summary: The house is ready to move into and needs no special work. It offers 80 m² with a 20 m² living room and wood-burning stove, a 20 m² fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom with shower and toilet, and two bedrooms upstairs. Outside there is a plot of land, an easy-to-maintain garden, an outbuilding and a cellar. The house sits in a small, peaceful hamlet near Nouzerines, Boussac and La Châtre. It suits a second home or weekends away. Asking €109,900, about €1,374/m².

homes.title: Renovated detached house with large terrace and open fireplace in Erp, Ariège
homes.title_es: Casa independiente renovada con gran terraza y chimenea en Erp, Ariège
homes.summary: Detached country house renovated a few years ago with 2 bedrooms upstairs. The living room has an open fireplace, and there is a fully furnished modern kitchen and a large wooden terrace. A shower room, a toilet and a laundry room with a gas boiler and a cellar on the hillside complete the ground floor. It is heated by gas central heating, with the tank in the garden, and has double glazed windows. The house stands in a small hamlet 10 minutes from St Girons, with 7,535 sq ft of land. Asking €112,000, about €1,556/m².

homes.title: Renovated town house with a central patio in the centre of La Charité-sur-Loire, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa urbana renovada con patio central en el centro de La Charité-sur-Loire, Borgoña
homes.summary: A renovated town house in the centre of La Charité-sur-Loire, the old priory town on the Loire, with shops, schools and transport close by. 156 m² with six rooms, four of them bedrooms, arranged around a central patio, plus a redone 27 m² studio-type space with a new roof and a large cellar. Electrics redone, full insulation carried out in 2011, double glazing, mains gas heating, mains drainage and fibre available. Asking €119,500, about €766/m². Property tax €970 a year; the advert gives gas at about €1,200 and electricity about €1,000 a year.

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom village house with private garden and barn in Barro, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada de 2 dormitorios con jardín privado y granero en Barro, Charente
homes.summary: This renovated village house is ready to enjoy, with no works needed before moving in. It has 6 rooms, including 2 double bedrooms, each with its own en-suite shower room, and a separate laundry room. The property has a private fully enclosed garden with a pond and an additional outbuilding, plus a substantial barn across the quiet road with electricity and water connected. Oil-fired central heating is installed. Verteuil-sur-Charente, the nearby market town, is within easy reach. Asking €120,000, about €1,143/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden and swimming pool in Asnois, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín y piscina en Asnois, Vienne
homes.summary: This three-bedroom house stands in a small hamlet, with a large open-plan living area and a corner kitchen. All three bedrooms are on the first floor, and the ground floor living area has a wood-burning stove and exposed beams. Outside, there is a courtyard at the front, a garden with a swimming pool and terrace, a shed and a barn, on a plot of 30,247 sq ft of land. A village 3 km away has a school, post office, bar/restaurant and bakery. Asking €123,650, about €1,104/m².

homes.title: 5-bedroom townhouse with cellar and fireplace in Barbezieux-Saint-Hilaire, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 5 dormitorios con sótano y chimenea en Barbezieux-Saint-Hilaire, Charente
homes.summary: This townhouse in the city centre of Barbezieux-Saint-Hilaire offers 132 m2 of living space. It has six rooms, including five bedrooms, a 27.70 m2 living room, a 13.30 m2 kitchen and a large landing that could serve as an office or playroom. Features include a fireplace, a 20 m2 cellar, one parking space in front of the house and a plot of 484 sq ft of land. It is heated by wood and electric heating and has double glazing. Shops, schools and services are within walking distance. Asking €123,735, about €937/m².

homes.title: Well maintained 3-bedroom detached house with garage and terrace in Champagne-Mouton, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 3 dormitorios bien mantenida con garaje y terraza en Champagne-Mouton, Charente
homes.summary: This well maintained detached house has three bedrooms and a shower room upstairs, with a spacious kitchen/dining room, a sitting room and a separate WC on the ground floor. Outdoor features include a covered terrace, two courtyard gardens, a large garage and 2,852 sq ft of land. The sitting room has a fireplace with log burner, and the bedrooms have views. Gas central heating and fibre internet are installed. Champagne-Mouton is about ten minutes away, and Limoges airport is roughly an hour's drive. Asking €125,000, about €1,389/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, fireplace and land in Berrien, Finistère
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, chimenea y terreno en Berrien, Finistère
homes.summary: This village-centre house in Berrien is built over a full basement, with 107 m2 of living space. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a double living room with old fireplace, a kitchen and a large bedroom with shower room and toilet. Upstairs are two large bedrooms, each with shower room and toilet. Outdoors there is a small garden with a storage shed, 3,714 sq ft of land and one parking space. Heating is by an electric boiler, with bakery and school close by and Huelgoat 5 minutes away. Asking €126,600, about €1,183/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house with garden, parking and views in Lézignan-Corbières, Aude
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios con jardín, plaza de aparcamiento y vistas en Lézignan-Corbières, Aude
homes.summary: This 109 m2 house in Lézignan-Corbières has 2 bedrooms and a 40 m2 living room. Upstairs, the first bedroom has views over the roofs, and the second has a Velux. There is a garden of about 20 m2 and two parking spaces in a closed parking lot. Electric convectors are available for extra heating, and reversible air conditioning is fitted in the first bedroom. Double-glazed windows and a location close to schools complete the house. Asking €127,000, about €1,165/m².

homes.title: Former rectory house with garden, garage and land in Précy-sous-Thil, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Antigua casa rectoral con jardín, garaje y terreno en Précy-sous-Thil, Borgoña
homes.summary: This former rectory house adjoins the village church and keeps its period character. Inside, it has several rooms, including a ground-floor bedroom, with exposed beams and generous volumes. Outside, there is a green, quiet garden, a garage and 9,246 sq ft of land. The house has gas-fired central heating. It stands in the Auxois area of Burgundy, in a rural village setting. Asking €129,000, about €843/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom stone farmhouse with barn and open views in Courbiac, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de piedra de 2 dormitorios con granero y vistas abiertas en Courbiac, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This stone farmhouse dates from 1843 and offers 102 m2 of living space across two bedrooms, a kitchen of about 20 sqm with a fireplace. Outside there is an independent guest bedroom of about 16 sqm and a further room of about 11 sqm with toilet and shower room. An open barn of about 75 sqm and a plot of 3,625 sqm complete the property, which has open views and electric heating. It lies about 5 km from Montaigu-de-Quercy and Tournon d'Agenais. Asking €129,600, about €1,271/m².

homes.title: Country house with barn, garden and terrace in Champagne-Mouton, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con granero, jardín y terraza en Champagne-Mouton, Charente
homes.summary: This three-bedroom house sits in a peaceful, green setting near Champagne-Mouton. The ground floor offers a fitted kitchen, a dining room with a fireplace and wood-burning stove, a sitting room and two double bedrooms. Upstairs, a spacious third bedroom has an en-suite shower room and WC. Outside there is a fully enclosed rear terrace, a front garden with off-street parking, 6,727 sq ft of land and a large barn. It has double glazing, electric heating and stoves, with Limoges airport about an hour's drive. Asking €129,900, about €1,181/m².

homes.title: Three-bedroom house with terrace, garden and views in Espéraza, Aude
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios con terraza, jardín y vistas en Espéraza, Aude
homes.summary: This three-storey house in a quiet area of Espéraza offers 115 m2 of living space and seven rooms. It has three bedrooms, two shower rooms, an equipped separate kitchen, a dining room and a living room. Outdoor features include a covered terrace, three tiered gardens at the rear and views over Espéraza. The home has gas-fired central heating. Asking €130,000, about €1,130/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom bungalow with garden and terrace in Adriers, Vienne
homes.title_es: Bungalow de 4 dormitorios listo para entrar a vivir con jardín y terraza en Adriers, Vienne
homes.summary: This move-in ready detached bungalow is in good condition, with no work needed before you move in. It has 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, an open plan living and dining room with a woodburner, and a modern fitted kitchen. Outside are a garden, a terrace, a pergola, a boules pitch and a garden shed. There is also a fireplace, a garage, a cellar, and 8,579 sq ft of land. Oil-fired central heating is fitted, the village shops are within walking distance, and L'ilse Jourdain is a 7 minute drive. Asking €130,800, about €1,308/m².

homes.title: Move-in-ready detached house with garden, barn and terrace in Chamberet, Corrèze
homes.title_es: Casa independiente lista para entrar a vivir con jardín, granero y terraza en Chamberet, Corrèze
homes.summary: This detached house has 90 m² of living space, 3 bedrooms and 2 shower rooms with WCs. It is ready to move into and includes a fitted kitchen, a 25 m² living room with a wood-burning stove and oil-fired central heating. A south-east-facing wooden terrace and a flat garden surround the house, with a 30 m² timber barn, a 19 m² metal-roofed shed and an 18 m² garden shed. Shops and schools are close by, and the septic tank was recently installed. Asking €130,800, about €1,453/m².

homes.title: Restored 2-bedroom townhouse with garden and fireplace in Bourbonne-les-Bains, Haute-Marne
homes.title_es: Casa adosada restaurada de 2 dormitorios con jardín y chimenea en Bourbonne-les-Bains, Haute-Marne
homes.summary: Restored stone townhouse in a small spa town, suitable as a primary residence or second home. It has two bedrooms, a dressing room, a living room, an equipped kitchen, a shower room and a toilet, with a laundry room and convertible attics. A double-sided fireplace opens to both the kitchen and the living room. Outdoor features include a garden, a terrace, 13,929 sq ft of land and one parking space, with French doors leading to the grounds at the rear. Asking €138,000, about €1,169/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom village house with garden and fireplace in Saint-Pierre-de-Maillé, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 3 dormitorios con jardín y chimenea en Saint-Pierre-de-Maillé, Vienne
homes.summary: This village house in a quiet setting offers 118 m² of living space over two floors. The ground floor has a 39 m² living room with an insert fireplace, a fitted kitchen, a utility room, a shower room and a separate WC, and the first floor has three bedrooms. It has a garden, an adjoining garage, a courtyard with vehicle access and 266 m² of land. Heating comes from a wood pellet boiler, and there is a convertible attic. Asking €138,500, about €1,174/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and terrace in Montluçon, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en Montluçon, Allier
homes.summary: Renovated to a high standard, this four-room house is in the Ilets area of Montluçon. It has three bedrooms, a double living room with veranda access, a fitted kitchen, a shower room and a separate toilet. The garden level adds a bedroom, a summer kitchen, a laundry room, a cellar and a workshop. Outdoor features include a garden, a terrace, 11,377 sq ft of land, a garage and two parking spaces. Energy rating D, with estimated annual energy costs of €1,774 to €2,400. Asking €139,000, about €1,209/m².

homes.title: Restored 3-bedroom house with garden and terrace in Saint-Antonin-Noble-Val, Tarn-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa restaurada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en Saint-Antonin-Noble-Val, Tarn-et-Garonne
homes.summary: Restored period house of about 110 m2 with three bedrooms and a shower room. The 40 m2 living room has a wood-burning stove, and the kitchen has a dining area and an insert fireplace. Further features include a south-facing 50 m2 terrace, a garden, a large garage and a cellar. A separate 400 m2 plot of land lies nearby, not adjoining the property. The house is in the historic bastide village of Saint-Antonin-Noble-Val, with shops. Asking €139,000, about €1,264/m².

homes.title: Two-level 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Gros-Chastang, Corrèze
homes.title_es: Casa de dos plantas de 4 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y garaje en Gros-Chastang, Corrèze
homes.summary: This 130 m² house arranged over two levels has four bedrooms and two bathrooms. The 36 m² living and dining room opens onto a terrace and a tree-lined garden of 1,200 m² at the rear, with no overlooking neighbours. The property also includes an attached garage, a utility room, a study and 11.5 m² of convertible attic space. The plot covers 12,917 sq ft of land in a quiet, pleasant setting. Asking €139,000, about €1,069/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house in good condition with garden and views in Dommartin, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios en buen estado con jardín y vistas en Dommartin, Borgoña
homes.summary: This house is in good condition, with 120 m2 of living space, 3 bedrooms and 1 shower room. The ground floor has a dining room with open kitchen and a lounge opening to the terrace. Features include a garden, a fireplace or wood stove, a detached garage, a cellar and outbuildings, plus an unobstructed view. Oil central heating and solar-powered hot water are provided. The village is close to the amenities of Moulins-Engilbert and Château-Chinon. Asking €140,000, about €1,167/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom stone house with garden and land in Le Gué-de-Velluire, Vendée
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y terreno en Le Gué-de-Velluire, Vendée
homes.summary: Renovated stone house that requires no work, with 125 m2 of living space over two floors. Ground floor living area with original counter, office and kitchen; upstairs three bedrooms, shower room and separate toilet. Small garden and 1,216 sq ft of land, with electric heating and double glazing. Nursery and grocery store a few minutes by car, elementary school a 10-minute walk, restaurant and GP a 5-minute walk. Asking €143,750, about €1,150/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom townhouse with garden and terrace facing the Lot River in Clairac, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y terraza frente al río Lot en Clairac, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This townhouse in Clairac, Lot-et-Garonne, has three bedrooms, a shower room and a WC spread across three levels. The ground floor includes an entrance hall, storage room, laundry room and cellar, while the first floor has an open-plan living room and fully equipped kitchen with a WC. Outside, there is a private terrace and a landscaped garden on 2,153 sq ft of land, and the property faces the Lot River. Collective central heating is installed. The town centre and amenities are close by. Asking €143,800, about €1,106/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom house with garden, fireplace and land in Bossay-sur-Claise, Indre-et-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios con jardín, chimenea y terreno en Bossay-sur-Claise, Indre-et-Loire
homes.summary: This house in Bossay-sur-Claise offers 120 m2 of living space across five rooms. The ground floor includes a kitchen, dining room, two bedrooms and a shower room with WC. Upstairs, there are two more bedrooms and a washbasin corner, while the basement holds a garage, boiler room and workshop. The property also has a garden, a fireplace, a cellar, a well, and land with a second plot bordering a river. Oil-fired central heating is installed. Asking €144,000, about €1,200/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom stone house with garden and swimming pool in Arques, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada de 2 dormitorios con jardín y piscina en Arques, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: Renovated stone house in the heart of a village, formerly a village café, with 137.96 m2 of living space. It has 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, with a 41.12 m2 living room opening onto a 195 m2 garden, a fitted kitchen opening onto a 17 m2 terrace, and a second-floor room with a 5.72 m2 terrace. The property includes an above-ground swimming pool and 3,122 sq ft of land. The village is in the Corbières vertes, with numerous hiking trails and multiple natural sites. Asking €148,400, about €1,083/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom townhouse with fireplace and terrace in La Châtre, Indre
homes.title_es: Casa adosada lista para entrar a vivir de 3 dormitorios con chimenea y terraza en La Châtre, Indre
homes.summary: This move-in ready townhouse in the heart of La Châtre needs no work before you move in. It has three bedrooms, one bathroom, a shower room, separate toilets and a 45 m² living room with parquet flooring and a fireplace. An open plan equipped kitchen, a garden, a terrace, a cellar and 226 sq ft of land complete the home. Oil-fired central heating is installed, and all amenities are within walking distance. Asking €159,000, about €1,060/m².

homes.title: Stone house with garden and wood-burning stove in Angliers, Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con jardín y estufa de leña en Angliers, Vienne
homes.summary: Stone house retaining its period character, with 165 m² of living space and two bedrooms. The living room has a wood-burning stove insert and a mezzanine, and a large conservatory opens onto the kitchen and dining area. The ground floor also holds a primary bedroom suite with bathroom and shower, a WC, and a home office with shower room and WC, while an additional bedroom is upstairs. Outside, the 780 m² garden has numerous trees, two garden sheds and a well, and the conservatory has views over it. Heating is electric. Asking €168,500, about €1,021/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom village house with fireplace and large garden in Les Forges, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 3 dormitorios con chimenea y gran jardín en Les Forges, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: Immaculate 3-bedroom village house with 115 m2 of living space, 2 bathrooms, and a structure and exterior in good condition. The double aspect lounge has a feature fireplace, and the fully fitted kitchen includes an oven, induction hob and dishwasher. Electric heating and a gravelled terrace lead to a large rear garden of around 3,000 m2 that extends into woodland. A bio shop, restaurant and golf course are within walking distance. Poitiers, with an international airport and TGV station, is 30 minutes away. Asking €179,983, about €1,565/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Lavault-Sainte-Anne, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Lavault-Sainte-Anne, Allier
homes.summary: Fully renovated five-room house with 135 m2 of living space over two floors. The ground floor has a large entrance hall, a fitted kitchen, a living room and a toilet, while the upper floor offers a second fitted kitchen, a large living room, three bedrooms, a shower room and a toilet. The property includes a garage, a cellar, a terrace, an outbuilding and an enclosed garden on 7,535 sq ft of land. Energy rating is D and climate rating is C. Asking €192,000, about €1,422/m².

homes.title: House with renovated bathrooms and troglodyte cellar in Montoire-sur-le-Loir, Loir-et-Cher
homes.title_es: Casa con baños reformados y bodega troglodita en Montoire-sur-le-Loir, Loir-et-Cher
homes.summary: This 142 m2 house has renovated bathrooms, aluminum joinery and mains drainage, with electric heating and a recent wood stove in the living room. The ground floor has a large dining kitchen opening onto the terrace, a bedroom with a shower room and toilet, and a laundry room. Upstairs, two bedrooms include a 32 m2 suite. The 1,125 m2 plot includes a large troglodyte cellar, and the house sits in a very quiet setting 10 minutes from Montoire-sur-le-Loir. Asking €199,000, about €1,401/m².

homes.title: Studio with a view over the port of Marseille, gated residence
homes.title_es: Estudio con vistas al puerto de Marsella, residencia cerrada
homes.summary: 28 m² on the 3rd floor with a lift, in a gated residence with a caretaker: a bright room with an open green kitchen, a shower room and a wide view over the port. Collective gas heating and hot water, free parking inside the residence. Asking €54,000, about €1,929/m².

homes.title: Modern two-room flat with an open kitchen near the universities, Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Piso moderno de dos habitaciones con cocina abierta junto a las universidades, Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: 40 m² on the 2nd floor of a small building on rue de Tardy: an open kitchen with a breakfast bar onto the living room, a bedroom with its own shower room and a separate WC. PVC double glazing, low charges, good condition. Asking €54,000, about €1,350/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with converted attic and new roof in Leugny, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con buhardilla convertida y tejado nuevo en Leugny, Borgoña
homes.summary: House in Leugny, Burgundy, with a fitted kitchen open to the living area, a shower room and a toilet. The first level has 2 bedrooms and a room used as a bedroom, plus a bedroom in the converted attic. The roof was renewed in 2024 under a ten-year warranty, and the home has PVC double-glazed windows and a 300-litre hot water tank. Heating is electric, with fan heaters in the bathroom. Toucy, with its shops, doctors and schools, is about 9 km away. Asking €66,000, about €904/m².

homes.title: Townhouse in good condition with 2 bedrooms and covered outdoor area in Tournus, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa adosada en buen estado con 2 dormitorios y zona exterior cubierta en Tournus, Borgoña
homes.summary: This townhouse in good condition sits in the historic centre of Tournus, within walking distance of all amenities. The ground floor has a living and dining room, a fitted kitchen, a small covered outdoor area under a glass roof, a laundry area and a separate toilet, while the first floor has a bedroom and a shower room with toilet. A second bedroom sits above a landing and office area with a Velux roof window. Mains gas heating with a recent boiler also provides hot water, and the windows are double glazed. Asking €89,000, about €1,112/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with garden and outbuildings in Voultegon, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 2 dormitorios con jardín y dependencias en Voultegon, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: Renovated house in an attractive village in the north of Deux-Sèvres, refurbished about 15 years ago with a new kitchen and shower room. It has a dining room, a sitting room, a refitted kitchen, a shower room with WC and two first floor bedrooms. The enclosed rear garden has a terraced area, plus two outbuildings and a covered area with a Jacuzzi, on 4,715 sq ft of land. The house has wood heating, and Bressuire is about 15 minutes south. Asking €99,000, about €1,320/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom farmhouse with garage, cellar and outbuilding in Chailley, Yonne, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Granja de 2 dormitorios con garaje, sótano y anexo en Chailley, Yonne, Borgoña
homes.summary: This 110 m² farmhouse sits in Le Vaudevanne, a hamlet of Chailley. The ground floor has a living room, a dining room with a fitted kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room with a toilet, while upstairs there is a large bedroom, a second shower room, a toilet and an attic that could be converted into an extra bedroom. It includes a garage, a cellar, an outbuilding with a bread oven, two shelters and 884 m² of enclosed, tree-lined land. Electric heating is installed. Asking €110,000, about €1,000/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with garden and terrace in Saint-Vincent-de-Connezac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 2 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en Saint-Vincent-de-Connezac, Dordoña
homes.summary: Renovated village house with two bedrooms and a wood burner, ready to move into. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a lounge, dining room and kitchen, and a WC. Upstairs, there is a master bedroom with a balcony, a second bedroom and a shower room with WC. Outdoor space includes an enclosed courtyard garden of 50 m2, an enclosed terrace and 1,173 sq ft of land. It has double glazing and electric heating, with shops in walking distance and Riberac a short drive away. Asking €115,000, about €1,353/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and outbuildings in Saint-Denis-de-Jouhet, Indre
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y dependencias en Saint-Denis-de-Jouhet, Indre
homes.summary: This 3-bedroom house sits in a green setting in Saint-Denis-de-Jouhet, Indre. It has 6 rooms, including a kitchen, a living room, a dining room with a fireplace and a small conservatory, plus a shower room and a separate toilet. Outside you will find an enclosed garden, a covered terrace, a garage and a parking space, plus a large tree-lined plot with a pond and several outbuildings including a converted barn. It has double glazing and electric heating. Asking €116,600, about €1,110/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom village house with mountain views and land in Castanet-le-Haut, Hérault
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 2 dormitorios con vistas a las montañas y terreno en Castanet-le-Haut, Hérault
