homes.summary: This village house on two floors stands in the hamlet of Pabo, about 10 minutes from Saint-Gervais-sur-Mare. It has two bedrooms, a shower room, a separate equipped kitchen and a light-filled living room. Outdoor and extra features include uninterrupted mountain views, a balcony, 947 sq ft of land, a fireplace, a cellar and one parking space directly in front of the house. The home has oil-fired central heating. Asking €119,000, about €1,280/m².

homes.title: Stone house with fireplace, balcony and cellar in Tournon-d'Agenais, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con chimenea, balcón y sótano en Tournon-d'Agenais, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This stone house in a royal bastide village stands a short walk from the main square. It has a large 45 m² living room with a fireplace and an open plan kitchen. Upstairs there are two bedrooms, one with a fireplace and balcony access, plus a shower room, and a third bedroom in the attic. The property also has a cellar, a small front terrace and 753 sq ft of land. Electric heating is listed. Asking €119,000, about €1,190/m².

homes.title: 19th-century stone village house with wisteria courtyard and terrace in Frayssinet, Lot
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de piedra del siglo XIX con patio de glicina y terraza en Frayssinet, Lot
homes.summary: A 19th-century stone house on a quiet lane in a peaceful village in the Lot, in Occitanie. About 113 m² with a generous sitting room, a kitchen diner with modern appliances, three bedrooms, one of them on the ground floor, and two shower rooms. The agent describes it as comfortable and habitable as it stands. Behind stone walls there is a private courtyard shaded by mature wisteria and a raised terrace. Glazing and heating could be upgraded over time, as the advert says. Shops are about 10 minutes away and a larger town with a railway station 20 minutes. Asking €125,000 including fees, about €1,106/m².

homes.title: House with garden, orchard and garage in Saint-Christophe-en-Brionnais, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa con jardín, huerto y garaje en Saint-Christophe-en-Brionnais, Borgoña
homes.summary: This house in a village in Brionnais has about 118 m2 of living space. Downstairs are a large fitted kitchen, a living room with a fireplace insert, a pantry, a bathroom and a separate WC. Upstairs are two large bedrooms, a small attic bedroom, an office and a shower room. Outside there is a garden with a well, an orchard with a tunnel, a workshop and a separate garage on 1713 m2 of land. Heating is gas central heating by tank. Asking €125,100, about €1,060/m².

homes.title: House in good condition with terrace, fireplace and cellar in Langeac, Haute-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa en buen estado con terraza, chimenea y sótano en Langeac, Haute-Loire
homes.summary: This house is in good condition and has 7 rooms, including 4 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The equipped kitchen has tiled floors, and the rest of the home has parquet floors. Outdoor and extra features include a terrace, a fireplace, a cellar and 269 sq ft of land. Heating is by wood, with a pellet stove in the living room, and the home has no overlooking neighbours. Langeac is about one hour from Clermont-Ferrand and 45 minutes from Le Puy en Velay. Asking €127,000, about €1,270/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom house with terraces, garden and views in Merry-Sec, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios totalmente reformada con terrazas, jardín y vistas en Merry-Sec, Borgoña
homes.summary: This fully renovated house spans two levels in a hamlet 20 km south of Auxerre. The ground floor has a large living room with a wood-burning stove, an open-plan kitchen, a shower room and a garage. Upstairs there are two bedrooms, a bathroom and a 44 m² room opening onto a second terrace. Outside there is a garden, a rear terrace and a large sloping plot with open views over the countryside. Heating comes from electric, aerothermal and reversible heat pumps, and Ouanne, with a school, is a few kilometres away. Asking €129,600, about €1,045/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom house with land and fireplace in Ladignac-le-Long, Haute-Vienne
homes.title_es: Casa totalmente reformada de 3 dormitorios con terreno y chimenea en Ladignac-le-Long, Haute-Vienne
homes.summary: This fully renovated house is ready to move into, with three bedrooms and one bathroom. The ground floor has a large living room with a wood-burning stove, a separate kitchen, and a bedroom with its own shower room and private WC. Upstairs, a landing leads to two large bedrooms and a bathroom with WC. The house has a fireplace and a plot of land at the rear, and it is heated by wood. Ladignac-le-Long is about ten minutes from Saint-Yrieix-la-Perche. Asking €130,000, about €1,226/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom stone house with garden and courtyard in Mézin, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios con jardín y patio en Mézin, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This authentic stone house sits in the heart of a village with 145 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a kitchen, a dining room and a living room, and upstairs are three bedrooms, a bathroom with toilet, a shower room and a separate toilet. Outside, you will find a 145 m2 courtyard, a garden, a storage room and 2,852 sq ft of land. The home has electric heating, and Mézin is 10 minutes away. Asking €130,000, about €897/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom character house with garden in Sainte-Foy-la-Grande, Gironde
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter de 3 dormitorios totalmente reformada con jardín en Sainte-Foy-la-Grande, Gironda
homes.summary: Fully renovated character house with a completely redone structure, new electrics and plumbing, and a roof redone in 2017. It has three bedrooms, a wood-finished living room, a functional kitchen, a shower room, a separate WC and a dormitory-style second floor that can be reconfigured into at least two more bedrooms. Outdoor space includes a private courtyard of about 10 m² and a garden, plus 108 sq ft of land. No work is needed, so it can be occupied straight away. Asking €133,000, about €1,279/m².

homes.title: Spacious house with garden, terrace and garage in Villeneuve-sur-Lot, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa espaciosa con jardín, terraza y garaje en Villeneuve-sur-Lot, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This 1960s house, built over a basement, has five bedrooms and 128 m2 of living space. Upstairs, an entrance hall leads to an open-plan living area of about 40 m2 with kitchen, living room and dining room, plus three bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate toilet. The basement holds a 34 m2 garage, a 23 m2 laundry room, two further bedrooms, an office and a second toilet. A fenced, landscaped garden of about 415 m2 has a terrace, and there is one parking space. Collective central heating is installed. Asking €134,000, about €1,047/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom farmhouse with garden and cellar in Prats-de-Mollo-la-Preste, Pyrénées-Orientales
homes.title_es: Masía de 3 dormitorios con jardín y bodega en Prats-de-Mollo-la-Preste, Pyrénées-Orientales
homes.summary: This Catalan farmhouse in Prats-de-Mollo-la-Preste offers 112 m2 of living space over two floors. The ground floor has a dining room with wood stove, a living room, a kitchen and a storage room, while the first floor has 3 bedrooms, an office and a shower room with WC. The house faces south and sits on 35,295 sq ft of land. Extra features include a garden, a fireplace, a vaulted cellar, a paillère, an independent workshop and more than 190 m2 of annexes. Asking €135,000, about €1,205/m².

homes.title: Stone 3-bedroom house with terrace, land and garage in Saint-Martial-de-Gimel, Corrèze
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios con terraza, terreno y garaje en Saint-Martial-de-Gimel, Corrèze
homes.summary: Charming stone house in the heart of the village of Saint-Martial-de-Gimel, close to amenities. The home has 110 m2 of living space, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, plus separate toilets, a kitchen opening onto a balcony and a bright living room with dining area. Outdoor and extra features include a terrace, land, a garage, a workshop, an outbuilding, a cellar and an attic. Heating is by wood stove, electric underfloor heating and reversible air conditioning, and the windows are double-glazed. Asking €135,000, about €1,227/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom stone house with garden and garage in Langast, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Langast, Bretaña
homes.summary: Independent stone house under slate in Langast with 115 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a furnished kitchen, a living room with a wood stove, a bedroom, a bathroom, a toilet and a veranda, and the first floor has a mezzanine living room, two bedrooms, a shower room and a toilet. It has 789 m2 of garden, and a separate 1,520 m2 plot is not attached. The basement has a cellar, laundry area, boiler room and garage. Oil-fired central heating is fitted. Asking €138,000, about €1,200/m².

homes.title: Stone house with 1454 m² garden in Faux-en-Périgord, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con jardín de 1454 m² en Faux-en-Périgord, Dordogne
homes.summary: This 117 m² stone house with a rendered facade is in the village of Faux-en-Périgord, which has local shops. It offers a kitchen, living room, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom and a shower room. The garden sits on a plot of 1454 m² with mature trees. The house has propane gas central heating, is connected to mains drainage, and Bergerac airport is about 10 minutes away. Asking €138,450, about €1,183/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready house with garden, barn and wood stove in Saint-Jeanvrin, Cher
homes.title_es: Casa lista para entrar a vivir con jardín, granero y estufa de leña en Saint-Jeanvrin, Cher
homes.summary: This move-in ready house is professionally renovated and well maintained. It has a living room, a kitchen with a central island, a utility room, and bedrooms on both floors. The 1,200 m² garden has a barn, a covered parking shelter, a well and a pond, with a shaded seating area. Heating is electric with a new wood-burning stove, and Châteaumeillant is about 6 minutes by car. Asking €139,000, about €1,112/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom house with garden and terrace in Uzerche, Corrèze
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios con jardín y terraza en Uzerche, Corrèze
homes.summary: This is a house in Uzerche, a town with shops and amenities close by. The living area measures 115 m2 across six rooms, including four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Outdoors there is a garden, a terrace, a cellar and about 663 m² of terraced land, with an adjoining outbuilding that has direct access to the land. Heating is provided by electric convectors and a wood-burning stove. Asking €140,000, about €1,217/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and cellar in Noyers-Saint-Martin, Oise
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y sótano en Noyers-Saint-Martin, Oise
homes.summary: This 5-room house offers 110 m2 of living space on a 583 m2 plot. The ground floor has a dining room, living room, kitchen, bedroom, shower room and WC, and upstairs there is an office and two bedrooms. The property includes a garden, a terrace, land, a cellar and a garage. It has electric heating. Asking €141,000, about €1,282/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden bordering forest in Mennevret, Aisne
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín que linda con el bosque en Mennevret, Aisne
homes.summary: This house sits in a peaceful cul-de-sac on the edge of the forest. The ground floor has a 31 m2 living room with a fireplace, a 16 m2 kitchen with forest views, a bedroom, a bathroom and a separate toilet. Upstairs, two attic bedrooms of 15 m2 and 18 m2 open off a 16.5 m2 landing. Outdoors there is a garden bordering the forest, a terrace, a small cellar, outbuildings, 8,396 sq ft of land and one parking space. Heating is oil-fired collective central heating. Asking €147,500, about €1,199/m².

homes.title: Traditional 3-bedroom house with double garage and large plot in Bonnat, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional de 3 dormitorios con garaje doble y gran parcela en Bonnat, Creuse
homes.summary: This traditional house stands on a small country lane leading down to the Petite Creuse river. It has three bedrooms, a 33 m² dining room with a fireplace, a 14 m² kitchen with a wood-burning stove and an 18 m² living room. The house has double-glazed windows and fibre broadband is available. The 2,343 m² plot includes a garden, a double garage and a garden shed. The home has electric heating, and Bonnat with its shops is a 5-minute drive away. Asking €149,000, about €1,146/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom house with terrace and views in Fenouillet-du-Razès, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo totalmente reformada con terraza y vistas en Fenouillet-du-Razès, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This fully renovated village house has three bedrooms and one bathroom, plus a second shower room. The large living area has a fireplace and a fitted, equipped kitchen. The 20 m² terrace has an unobstructed view, and there is a cellar carved into the rock and an attic on the second floor. The house has electric heating, 112 m² of living space and land. Asking €149,000, about €1,330/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated adjoining houses with garden and land in Simorre, Gers
homes.title_es: Dos casas adosadas totalmente reformadas con jardín y terreno en Simorre, Gers
homes.summary: This fully renovated property in the heart of Simorre village consists of two adjoining houses with 131 m2 of living space. The two houses can be used as a single home or separated into two independent accommodations, with four bedrooms and seven rooms in total. The outdoor space includes a garden and 570 sq ft of land. The home has electric heating and a south orientation. Asking €150,000, about €1,145/m².

homes.title: Renovated 4-bedroom house with garden and fireplace in Vallon-en-Sully, Allier
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 4 dormitorios con jardín y chimenea en Vallon-en-Sully, Allier
homes.summary: Tastefully renovated house with spacious rooms and a recently fitted kitchen. The ground floor has a living and dining room of about 47 m² with a fireplace insert and access to the balcony. Three bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate toilet sit above a basement of about 100 m² with a garage, cellar and a heated room that could become a bedroom or office. The enclosed, tree-lined plot of about 4,464 m² offers generous outdoor space, and shops are close by. Asking €214,000, about €1,427/m².

homes.title: Furnished loft-style studio with a new bathroom in the hyper-centre, Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Estudio tipo loft amueblado con baño nuevo en pleno centro, Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: On the 5th floor with a lift of a bourgeois building at 16 rue de la Résistance, three minutes from place Jean-Jaurès: a 26.5 m² living room with kitchen under wooden beams, a sleeping mezzanine and a bathroom redone in July 2026, plus a vaulted cellar. Sold furnished. Asking €55,500, about €1,576/m².

homes.title: 2-bed country cottage in a lovely hamlet
homes.title_es: Casita de campo de 2 dormitorios en una aldea preciosa
homes.summary: Country cottage in an adorable hamlet : Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Nouvelle-Aquitaine A bright kitchen, rustic warmth, and plenty of outdoor space give this two-bedroom country cottage a wonderfully relaxed character.

homes.title: Move-in ready 1-bedroom house with garden and views in Montigny-sur-Canne, Nièvre, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de 1 dormitorio lista para entrar, con jardín y vistas en Montigny-sur-Canne, Nièvre, Borgoña
homes.summary: Move-in ready house in a quiet hamlet near Montigny-sur-Canne, with one bedroom, a separate kitchen and a shower room. A wood-burning stove heats the living room, and new electric radiators add comfort. The 1,400 m² plot has a garden with terrace, fruit trees, views, oak trees, and a workshop and wood storage area. The loft is reached by a ladder and has preparations for an extra bathroom, with the Morvan Regional Natural Park a short distance away. Asking €99,000, about €1,320/m².

homes.title: Stone house with garden, garage and cellar in Longré, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con jardín, garaje y sótano en Longré, Charente
homes.summary: This stone house in a typical Charentais village offers a peaceful, bucolic setting. It has a kitchen with dining area, a sitting room, a ground floor bedroom, a bathroom and an upstairs bedroom. The insulated attic could be converted into a bedroom, and the cellar offers extra storage. Outdoors there is an 840 m² south-east facing garden, a large 55 m² garage with workshop area, a fireplace and 9,074 sq ft of land. Heating is electric. Asking €113,400, about €1,303/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom townhouse with wood stove and land in Mortagne-sur-Gironde, Charente-Maritime
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 2 dormitorios con estufa de leña y terreno en Mortagne-sur-Gironde, Charente-Maritime
homes.summary: This 115 m2 townhouse in the village of Mortagne-sur-Gironde has two bedrooms and a plot of 775 sq ft of land. The ground floor has a living, dining and kitchen room of 31 m2 with a wood stove, plus a separate toilet. Upstairs are a bedroom with a dressing room, a bathroom and a top-floor office with a shower room. Shops are within walking distance, and the village port and Gironde estuary are nearby. The home has PVC double glazing, sewer connection and redone electricity and insulation. Asking €120,750, about €1,050/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 1-bedroom village house with beams in Palalda, Pyrénées-Orientales
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo lista para entrar a vivir, de 1 dormitorio y con vigas en Palalda, Pyrénées-Orientales
homes.summary: This move-in ready village house in Palalda offers 97 m2 of living space across 3 rooms. It has 1 bedroom, 1 shower room and an equipped kitchen, and it is offered fully furnished. Old timber beams, exposed stone walls and high ceilings give it a loft-style feel. An additional space can be used as a laundry room or for parking a scooter or motorcycle. The home has electric heating and orientation to the south and east. Asking €130,600, about €1,346/m².

homes.title: Character 3-bedroom house with walled garden in Saint-Clémentin, Deux-Sèvres
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter de 3 dormitorios con jardín amurallado en Saint-Clémentin, Deux-Sèvres
homes.summary: This character house is arranged over three levels with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The ground floor has an entrance hall, an equipped kitchen, a dining room opening onto the garden, a shower room and a separate WC, with access to the cellar. The walled rear garden includes an outbuilding, and the property has a fireplace and 2,756 sq ft of land. It has gas-fired central heating, double glazing and mains drainage, and Bressuire is 15 minutes away. Asking €130,800, about €1,222/m².

homes.title: Family house with garage, fireplace and 400 m² plot in Ambrières-les-Vallées, Mayenne
homes.title_es: Casa familiar con garaje, chimenea y parcela de 400 m² en Ambrières-les-Vallées, Mayenne
homes.summary: This family house of about 125 m² has a finished basement room and a ground-floor bedroom. The finished room could serve as an office, a work-from-home area or a teenager's bedroom. Outside, a plot of about 400 m² offers space to relax, and a garage can also store pellets. The home has a fireplace and central heating powered by a pellet stove. It is a short walk from shops and schools. Asking €132,000, about €1,056/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom townhouse with terrace and garden in Chémeré-le-Roi, Mayenne
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 3 dormitorios con terraza y jardín en Chémeré-le-Roi, Mayenne
homes.summary: This character townhouse in the historic centre of Chémeré-le-Roi was formed by joining three former houses. It has three bedrooms, a 118 m² living area, a 36 m² living room with a wood stove insert and a 15 m² fitted kitchen opening onto an 18 m² terrace. Extras include a garden, cellars, attics, an outbuilding and a utilitarian shed. Heating is by wood and electricity, with PVC double-glazed windows and mains drainage. It is about 20 minutes from Sablé-sur-Sarthe and 30 minutes from Laval. Asking €137,000, about €1,161/m².

homes.title: Country house with fireplace, garden and outbuildings in Bessé-sur-Braye, Sarthe
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con chimenea, jardín y dependencias en Bessé-sur-Braye, Sarthe
homes.summary: This country house in Bessé-sur-Braye has 105 m2 of living space, 2 bedrooms and 1 shower room. The living room has an open fireplace, and the ground floor includes an office, a separate WC and a utility room. The 22,454 sq ft plot includes a garden, a terrace, a garage, 2 parking spaces, outbuildings and an underground cellar. Heating comes from a heat pump installed in 2026, with double-glazed windows and doors. The house is 35 minutes from Vendôme TGV station. Asking €139,100, about €1,325/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Quillan, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y garaje en Quillan, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This 3-bedroom house with 114 m2 of living space sits in a quiet neighbourhood in Quillan. Its bright living room opens onto a veranda, and there is a separate kitchen, an additional sleeping area, two shower rooms and separate toilets. Outside you will find a landscaped garden, a terrace, 3,380 sq ft of land, and a garage with one parking space. Inside, a fireplace with a wood-burning stove, PVC double-glazed windows and gas central heating add comfort. Asking €145,000, about €1,272/m².

homes.title: 5-bedroom house with cellar, enclosed plot and hangar in Huelgoat, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa de 5 dormitorios con sótano, parcela cerrada y hangar en Huelgoat, Bretaña
homes.summary: This house offers 121 m2 of living space across five bedrooms. The ground floor has a veranda entrance, a kitchen, a dining room, a double living room, a shower room and a separate toilet. Upstairs, one bedroom has a shower room and toilet, and another has a bathtub and toilet. The property includes a cellar, an enclosed plot of 3,900 m2 and a small hangar, with land designated for development by the municipality. The lake is close by, and the town centre is a 10 minute walk away. Asking €147,700, about €1,221/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 5-bedroom family house with garden and garage in Ligueil, Indre-et-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa familiar de 5 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y garaje en Ligueil, Indre-et-Loire
homes.summary: This move-in ready family house is well maintained and needs no work. Inside you will find a bright living room, a fitted kitchen, five bedrooms, a shower room and a bathroom with WC. The full basement includes a garage, laundry room, workshop, boiler room and cellar. Outside there is an enclosed garden of about 750 m² plus land of 8,073 sq ft. Double glazing and mains drainage are included, and the home is close to local amenities in Ligueil. Asking €149,500, about €1,359/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated character house with 13th-century vaulted ceiling in Fabrezan, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter totalmente reformada con bóveda del siglo XIII en Fabrezan, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This fully renovated character house in Fabrezan has a 13th-century vaulted ceiling. It offers 3 bedrooms, a study and generous living spaces. The usable attic offers potential for conversion, and a car park near the house is available, though parking is not privately allocated. Double glazing is fitted and the energy rating is C. Lézignan-Corbières, Narbonne and the Mediterranean coast are close by. Asking €150,000, about €1,364/m².

homes.title: 5-bedroom house with garden and garage in Rostrenen, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa de 5 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Rostrenen, Bretaña
homes.summary: This 7-room house of 113 m2 in Rostrenen has five bedrooms, a shower room and separate toilets. The ground floor includes an entrance with storage, a kitchen, a living room dining room with south-facing windows and a fireplace, and a bedroom. Outside, the plot of 1,071 m2 has a garden, a conservatory and an outbuilding, and the full basement includes a garage. Heating comes from a heat pump and solar panels, with double-glazed windows and mains drainage. The sea is about 50 minutes away. Asking €152,000, about €1,345/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with terrace and courtyard in Chalon-sur-Saône, Saône-et-Loire
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con terraza y patio en Chalon-sur-Saône, Saône-et-Loire
homes.summary: This house was fully renovated in 1997 and offers 96 m2 Carrez area across three bedrooms. The ground floor has a double living room, fitted kitchen, shower room, WC and bedroom with dressing room, plus two bedrooms upstairs. A terrace, small front courtyard and 1,184 sq ft of land have orientation south and east. Heating is by condensing gas boiler, with reversible air conditioning upstairs. Asking €160,000, about €1,667/m².

homes.title: Turnkey 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Albi, Tarn
homes.title_es: Casa llave en mano de 3 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y garaje en Albi, Tarn
homes.summary: This turnkey home offers 96 m2 of living space, with 3 bedrooms and air conditioning in the 2 attic bedrooms. The kitchen opens onto a private terrace and a small garden, and the house has a fireplace, electric heating and a garage. The roof was redone in 2024 and the electrical installation is compliant. Shops, bus stops, schools and the university are within walking distance in west Albi. Asking €185,000, about €1,927/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house on the Canal du Nivernais in Champvert, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada en el Canal du Nivernais en Champvert, Borgoña
homes.summary: A stone village house with direct access to the towpath of the Canal du Nivernais, renovated over the years and sold as needing no work. About 160 m2 for 188,000 euros, so under 1,200 euros per m2. There is a 50 m2 living room with a pellet stove, a fitted kitchen with an island, two large bedrooms (one en suite) and a 30 m2 study in the former stables. The roof was redone in 2024, gas central heating dates from 2017 and the energy rating is C. Garden of 1,225 m2, 5 minutes from Decize. Property tax 890 euros a year.

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden and wood stove in Guémené-sur-Scorff, Morbihan
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín y estufa de leña en Guémené-sur-Scorff, Morbihan
homes.summary: This house in the centre of Guémené-sur-Scorff has 3 bedrooms and 116 m2 of living space. The ground floor offers an entrance hall, a fitted kitchen, a living room and a dining room with a wood-burning stove. Upstairs there are two bedrooms and a large bathroom, and the second floor holds a master suite with an en-suite shower room. It has a small garden, 1,087 sq ft of land and wood heating. Asking €125,080, about €1,078/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garden, garage and large plot in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con jardín, garaje y gran parcela en Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.summary: This three-bedroom family house stands on a large plot in the Charente countryside. It has a fully equipped kitchen, a large living room with a wood-burning stove and a shower room. Outside are an enclosed garden with mature trees, a garage, a parking space and an additional plot. Heating comes mainly from the stove, supplemented by electric radiators in the coldest months. The village of Nanteuil-en-Vallée is five minutes away. Asking €134,400, about €1,268/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom townhouse with garden and basement in Rostrenen, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa adosada lista para entrar a vivir de 4 dormitorios con jardín y sótano en Rostrenen, Bretaña
homes.summary: This move-in ready townhouse is well maintained and requires no work. It offers 6 rooms, including 4 bedrooms, a study, a fitted kitchen, a living and dining room, a bathroom and a shower room, plus a full basement of 57 m². The outdoor space includes a 220 m² garden and a plot of 2,971 sq ft of land, with the home attached on one side only. Heating comes from an oil-fired boiler, and the PVC double-glazed windows have electric and solar-powered shutters. Asking €139,000, about €1,264/m².

homes.title: Single-storey 3-bedroom stone house with terrace and garage in Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de una planta con 3 dormitorios, terraza y garaje en Bergerac, Dordoña
homes.summary: This single-storey stone house in Bergerac has period character and several improvements already made. It offers three bedrooms, a study, a separate kitchen and a living room with dining room. Outside are a fully enclosed 419 m² plot, a terrace, a garage and parking. A heat pump with air conditioning and a wood stove provide comfort. Schools and shops are nearby, but a busy road and railway line are close. Asking €148,000, about €1,345/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with countryside views and guest bungalow in Vosnon, Aube, Champagne-Ardenne
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con vistas al campo y bungalow para invitados en Vosnon, Aube, Champagne-Ardenne
homes.summary: This south-facing house is built on ecological and bioclimatic principles and offers 125 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a living room with a wood-burning stove, an open-plan fitted kitchen, a shower room and a toilet. Upstairs there is an office area and three bedrooms. The 1,055 sqm plot is fully enclosed, has a chestnut tree and offers views of countryside and forest, and a large bungalow suited as a studio or guest house stands on it. The village lies between Saint Florentin and Troyes. Asking €149,000, about €1,192/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom family house with garden and land in Blaye, Gironde
homes.title_es: Casa familiar de 4 dormitorios con jardín y terreno en Blaye, Gironda
homes.summary: This family house offers four bedrooms and a fitted, equipped kitchen across 118 m2 of living space, with two shower rooms. Its spacious living areas sit in a comfortable setting. The property includes a garden and 3,595 sq ft of land. The ground floor is fully accessible to people with reduced mobility, offering everyday comfort. It is around fifteen minutes from Blaye. Asking €149,900, about €1,270/m².

homes.title: Detached house with conservatory, enclosed garden and garage in Chauny, Aisne
homes.title_es: Casa independiente con veranda acristalada, jardín vallado y garaje en Chauny, Aisne
homes.summary: This detached house sits very close to Chauny in a quiet area with amenities nearby. The ground floor has a fitted and equipped kitchen, a cosy living room with a fireplace, a large study, a sleeping area, a bathroom and a separate toilet, plus a light-filled conservatory opening onto the garden. Upstairs, two bedrooms include one of about 20 m². The enclosed garden, courtyard parking, a garage and an outbuilding complete the property. Living area is 124 m2 on a land plot of 6,889 sq ft. Asking €149,900, about €1,209/m².

homes.title: Renovated village house with energy rating B in the centre of Riez, Verdon
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada con calificación energética B en el centro de Riez, Verdon
homes.summary: A 91 m2 village house on a small square in the centre of Riez, fully renovated to current standards and rated B for energy, which is rare for an old Provençal house. It has two kitchens and living areas over the lower floors, two bedrooms (one with its own shower), a bathroom, reversible air conditioning in three zones and about 50 m2 of cellars. A small courtyard behind a wrought iron gate fits a table. Shops, schools, a hospital and two weekly markets are in the village, and Lake Sainte-Croix and the Verdon gorges are minutes away. About 1,750 euros per m2.

homes.title: Village house with roof terrace and patio garden in Tressan, Hérault
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo con terraza en azotea y patio jardín en Tressan, Hérault
homes.summary: Detached village house on two floors with 68 m² of living space, two bedrooms and a shower room with WC, in excellent decorative condition. The two upstairs bedrooms have 3-metre ceilings, and the ground floor has a dual-aspect living room, a separate dining area and a fitted kitchen opening onto a 32 m² patio garden. A 9 m² roof terrace offers views, and a garden shed provides storage. The house has electric heating, and the beaches are about 25 km away. Asking €175,000, about €2,574/m².

homes.title: Breton stone house with a conservatory near the Térénez beaches in Plouezoc'h
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra bretona con invernadero cerca de las playas de Térénez en Plouezoc'h
homes.summary: A granite and slate Breton house 5 minutes from the Térénez beaches and sailing school. It has 88 m² plus a 20 m² glazed conservatory along the garden side. Downstairs are a kitchen with dining space, a living and dining room, a bedroom and a bathroom, so single-level living is possible. Upstairs are two more bedrooms and an open area for an office. The plot is about 520 m² with parking. The kitchen is modern, but the upstairs rooms keep old wallpaper and the bathroom is dated, so plan to redecorate. Energy rating E.

homes.title: Renovated Luberon village house with vaulted cellar in Saint-Martin-de-Castillon
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo del Luberon renovada con bodega abovedada en Saint-Martin-de-Castillon
homes.summary: A fully renovated village house of about 90 m2 in the Luberon hills, priced near the low end of the portal's local sales range per m2. The fitted kitchen opens onto a vaulted stone cellar and a small terrace, the bright living room has a wood stove and open views, and there are two bedrooms, a modern shower room, two toilets and a utility room. The photos show beamed ceilings and new finishes throughout. Shops and the village swimming pool are about 400 metres away. Asking 210,000 euros.

homes.title: Stone 3-bedroom house with fireplace and outbuilding in Quistinic, Morbihan, Brittany
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios con chimenea y anexo en Quistinic, Morbihan, Bretaña
homes.summary: This three-bedroom stone terraced house stands in the village of Quistinic. The ground floor has a kitchen, living room and dining room with a fireplace, plus a shower room and toilet, while two bedrooms sit upstairs. A separate outbuilding of about 24 m² stands outside the house, reached via the neighbours' gate. It has electric heating, mains drains and new windows fitted in August 2024. Baud is 12 km away, Bubry 8.1 km and Lorient 35 km. Asking €95,000, about €1,218/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom townhouse with walled garden and garage in Cognac, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 2 dormitorios con jardín amurallado y garaje en Cognac, Charente
homes.summary: This townhouse spans three floors and is located in Cognac, Charente. It has two bedrooms, a bathroom with WC, a living room and a bright kitchen. The walled garden of about 65 m² is accessed from the kitchen, and the ground floor has a garage for parking or storage. The property also includes 700 sq ft of land, electric heating and a large landing on the second floor. It is presented as an ideal property for a rental investment. Asking €97,000, about €1,293/m².

homes.title: Two-bedroom village house with garden and outbuildings in Charchigné, Mayenne
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 2 dormitorios con jardín y anexos en Charchigné, Mayenne
homes.summary: This is a village house in Charchigné, Mayenne, with two bedrooms and a shower room. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a dining room, a fitted kitchen, a living room with a wood-burning stove, and a bedroom, with a second bedroom and a WC upstairs. The fully enclosed garden is included, along with adjoining outbuildings for storage and DIY, and 10,236 sq ft of land. The home has electric heating. It is 8 minutes from Lassay-les-Châteaux. Asking €110,900, about €1,305/m².

homes.title: Two-bedroom barn conversion house with cellar in Montfort-sur-Boulzane, Aude, Languedoc
homes.title_es: Casa de dos dormitorios reconvertida de granero con sótano en Montfort-sur-Boulzane, Aude, Languedoc
homes.summary: This two-bedroom house is a barn conversion in the village of Montfort-sur-Boulzane. The 90 m2 living area includes a ground floor living room with French doors and a wood burner, a separate kitchen, and two bedrooms, each with a shower room. A cellar is included, and the house has double glazing. Heating is provided by a heat pump and a wood burner. Axat, with shops and a medical centre, is close by, and Perpignan, Carcassonne and Toulouse airports are nearby. Asking €117,000, about €1,300/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 2-bedroom house with garden, terrace and views in Nolay, Nièvre, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa totalmente reformada de 2 dormitorios con jardín, terraza y vistas en Nolay, Nièvre, Borgoña
homes.summary: Fully renovated house in a hamlet of Nolay, with two bedrooms and one bathroom, ready to move into. The ground floor has a semi-open-plan kitchen, a living room with exposed beams and a fireplace, and a veranda/dining room that opens onto the garden. The garden includes a terrace, a wooden shed, and views over copses and a monumental wash house, on a plot of 6,674 sq ft. A wood-burning stove heats the entire house, and the property sits at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. Asking €129,000, about €1,344/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom stone house with land in Outarville, Essonne, Île-de-France
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios con terreno en Outarville, Essonne, Île-de-France
homes.summary: This stone house in the village of Outarville has three floors. The ground floor has an open-plan kitchen with living room, plus a utility room with a boiler and storage space. The first floor has a landing, two large bedrooms, a large bathroom with shower and a separate toilet. The second floor has one large bedroom. The property has 689 sq ft of land, and shops and schools are on site, about 10 minutes south of Angerville. Asking €129,990, about €1,182/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with cellar and double glazing in Mortagne-sur-Gironde, Charente-Maritime
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con sótano y doble acristalamiento en Mortagne-sur-Gironde, Charente-Maritime
homes.summary: This three-level house in the center of the village has 101 m2 of living space. The ground floor has an entrance, a living room with electric shutters, and a kitchen and dining room of 32 m2. Upstairs there are three bedrooms and a bathroom with shower, sink and toilet. The house has a cellar of 14.25 m2, PVC double glazing and a new water heater. It has electric heating and no garden, with Meschers beaches 18.30 km away and Gémozac supermarkets 13.70 km away. Asking €138,000, about €1,366/m².

homes.title: Detached 5-bedroom house with garden and covered terrace in Tergnier, Aisne, Picardy
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 5 dormitorios con jardín y terraza cubierta en Tergnier, Aisne, Picardía
homes.summary: This detached family house has 105 m2 of living space and five bedrooms, one of them on the ground floor. The ground floor has a bathroom with bathtub and shower, a separate toilet, a laundry room and an equipped kitchen, with a dining room and a bright lounge. Upstairs there are four further bedrooms and a study. Outside you will find a garden, a covered terrace, a small outbuilding, a courtyard with vehicle access and parking, plus a cellar and 4,284 sq ft of land. Asking €139,000, about €1,324/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with garage and balconies in Valréas, Vaucluse, Provence
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con garaje y balcones en Valréas, Vaucluse, Provenza
homes.summary: This 115 m² house is ideally located in the heart of Valréas. It has 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a 32 m² living and dining room, a kitchen and a utility kitchen/laundry room. Features include a garage, a private 20 m² outdoor area, a small balcony off the kitchen and a large balcony off the living room. Heating is oil-fired central heating, with reversible air conditioning in 2 bedrooms, and the home has PVC double-glazed windows and insulated attic space. Asking €142,000, about €1,235/m².

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with terrace, chalet and land in Luxey, Landes
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con terraza, chalet y terreno en Luxey, Landes
homes.summary: This 115 m2 house stands in the centre of Luxey, close to its amenities. The ground floor has a living room, an open plan equipped kitchen and a laundry room with toilet. The first floor has 3 bedrooms and a bathroom. Outside there is a 30 m2 wooden terrace, a wood shelter, a 437 m2 plot and a removable 25 m2 chalet. Heating comes from a wood stove and electric radiators, with hot water from a solar-linked tank and mains drainage. Asking €147,000, about €1,278/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom period house with garden, land and outbuilding in Outarville, Loiret
homes.title_es: Casa de época de 2 dormitorios con jardín, terreno y dependencia en Outarville, Loiret
homes.summary: This period house in Outarville offers 110 m2 of living space, two bedrooms and one bathroom. The ground floor has an open-plan kitchen, a living and dining room with a fireplace, a bathroom and a separate WC. Outside you will find a terrace, a small garden, 3,154 sq ft of land and an outbuilding for storage or a workshop. A cellar completes the house, which has electric heating and recent double-glazed PVC windows. Asking €149,900, about €1,363/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom stone house with garden, garage and fireplace in Champagne-Mouton, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 4 dormitorios con jardín, garaje y chimenea en Champagne-Mouton, Charente
homes.summary: Traditional stone house in a hamlet on the edge of a small village, 8 km from Champagne-Mouton. The ground floor has one bedroom, a bathroom and a shower room, and three more bedrooms are upstairs. The 878 m² plot includes a garden and a garage, with a fireplace and wood-burning stove in the living area. The house has gas central heating and double-glazed windows, and sits between Civray and Champagne-Mouton. Asking €149,950, about €1,271/m².

homes.title: Town centre 3-bedroom house with garage and commercial premises in Auch, Gers
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios en el centro con garaje y local comercial en Auch, Gers
homes.summary: This house in the heart of Auch has living accommodation and commercial premises on the ground floor. It offers 136 m2 of living space, 8 rooms, 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The house includes a 25 m2 garage and a cellar, and it has gas-fired central heating. The ground-floor premises are easily accessible and can suit various types of business, or a home with rental potential. Asking €150,000, about €1,103/m².

homes.title: Renovated single-storey house with garden and garage in Liffol-le-Grand, Vosges
homes.title_es: Casa de una planta renovada con jardín y garaje en Liffol-le-Grand, Vosges
homes.summary: Recently renovated single-storey house with 87 m² of living space, 3 bedrooms, a shower room and a separate toilet. The fitted kitchen with a central island opens onto a living room with a pellet stove. A south-east-facing terrace with a pergola leads to an enclosed garden with mature trees, and the 1,007 m² plot includes a wooden shed and parking for several vehicles. The garage also serves as a utility room. It stands in a quiet area close to shops and services. Asking €175,000, about €2,011/m².

homes.title: One-bedroom flat four minutes' walk from Grenoble station
homes.title_es: Piso de un dormitorio a cuatro minutos a pie de la estación de Grenoble
homes.summary: 33 m² on the ground floor in the Chorier-Berriat area: a living room with a kitchen, a separate 9.6 m² bedroom and a shower room, freshly painted with new floors. Grenoble station is a four-minute walk and six bus lines stop five minutes away. Energy rating F (electric heating). Asking €59,000, about €1,777/m².

homes.title: Village house with 2 bedrooms, fireplace and garage in Peyruis, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo con 2 dormitorios, chimenea y garaje en Peyruis, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence
homes.summary: This village house in Peyruis is arranged over three levels with two separate entrances. It has two bedrooms, a living room with a fireplace, a fitted kitchen and a bathroom with a laundry area. Features include a garage and two vaulted cellars, one below ground. It is a short walk from local shops and amenities, with quick access to the A51 motorway. The layout may allow division into two independent homes, subject to checks. Asking €134,500, about €1,245/m².

homes.title: Townhouse with 3 bedrooms and terrace near station in Agen, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 3 dormitorios con terraza cerca de la estación en Agen, Lot-et-Garonne
homes.summary: This townhouse is built on two levels. It has an open-plan kitchen opening onto the dining area, a separate living room, three bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate WC. Outside, there is a terrace for outdoor meals and a parking space near the house. The property is close to Agen railway station, with shops, transport and schools nearby. The advert notes that it is suited to a first-time buyer or an investor. Asking €139,000, about €1,264/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom village house with garden and garage in Cercy-la-Tour, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 4 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Cercy-la-Tour, Borgoña
homes.summary: This village house in Cercy-la-Tour has three levels, four bedrooms and 110 m2 of living area. It has an open-plan kitchen, dining area and living room on the ground floor, plus a shower room with WC upstairs. Outside, a garden of about 300 m2 includes an outbuilding with a garage and workshop, and the plot covers 4,036 sq ft of land. The Nivernais Canal and Aron River are within walking distance, and the house has central wood heating with electric backup. Asking €139,500, about €1,268/m².

homes.title: Stone house with fireplaces and land in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con chimeneas y terreno en Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
homes.summary: Stone house in one of the most beautiful villages in Charente, with exposed beams, stone walls, fireplaces and wooden floors. The ground floor has a 32 m² living room with a kitchen and wood-burning stove, and the first floor has a 20 m² bedroom with a fireplace. A 9 m² bathroom with bathtub, washbasin and toilet and a second bedroom on the upper floor complete the 108 m² of living space. The property includes 3,649 sq ft of land, with electric heating and a separate kitchen. Asking €142,000, about €1,315/m².

homes.title: Two-level house with land and attic in Peyremale, Gard
homes.title_es: Casa de dos niveles con terreno y desván en Peyremale, Gard
homes.summary: This two-level house in Peyremale offers 123 m2 of living space, with a kitchen, a living/dining room, an office, one bedroom and a separate toilet downstairs. Upstairs are two bedrooms and a large attic, and access between the floors is via the exterior only. The property also has a shower room, air conditioning and 6,566 sq ft of land. The home is heated by an air-to-water heat pump. Asking €150,000, about €1,220/m².

homes.title: Furnished 3-level village house with pellet stove in Sillans-la-Cascade, Var, Provence
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de tres plantas amueblada con estufa de pellets en Sillans-la-Cascade, Var, Provenza
homes.summary: Village house of 82 m² over three levels, sold furnished. The ground floor has a fitted open kitchen connected to the dining room and a storeroom. The first floor offers a shower room, a separate toilet and a space that can be a living room or a second bedroom, while the second floor has a large bedroom with a private toilet and hand basin. Heating is by pellet stove, with DPE rating C. It is on a quiet street with free public parking nearby. Asking €168,000, about €2,049/m².
